Plan Product Capacity business activity determine the design and organization of the production capacity management activities needed to meet changing demands for products over a period of time, as well as implement the plan for product capacity needs.
A Product's capacity plan ensures Product Management:

	• aligns capacity planning strategies with both commercial and operational goals,

	• ensures that there are sufficient product capacity to support planned and forecasted commercial objectives,

	• identifies gaps in capacity allocation early,

	• determines product capacity needs according to demand,

	• determines constraints and usage patterns over time,

	• forecasts future capacity needs,

	• and communicates products capacity requirements in time.

In the context of capacity planning, consideration is given to all input requirements, conversion processes and outputs when planning product capacity.

name: Align Product Capacity Planning Goals
brief_description: Align Product Capacity Planning Goals business activity is in charge of correlating the product capacity plans with business demand.
extended_description: Align Product Capacity Planning Goals business activity is in charge of correlating the product capacity plans with business demand.

name: Establish Product Capacity GAP
brief_description: Establish Product Capacity GAP business activity identifies any disparity between product capacity goals and business objectives.
extended_description: Establish Product Capacity GAP business activity identifies any disparity between product capacity goals and business objectives.

name: Forecast Product Capacity Need
brief_description: Forecast Product Capacity Need business activity develops projections that predict product capacity growth by understanding the impact on business.
extended_description: Forecast Product Capacity Need business activity develops projections that predict product capacity growth by understanding the impact on business.

name: Define Product Capacity Requirement
brief_description: Define Product Capacity Requirement business activity establishes, measures, and adjusts conditions that impact on planning product capacity for business expectations.
extended_description: Define Product Capacity Requirement business activity establishes, measures, and adjusts conditions that impact on planning product capacity for business expectations.

name: Establish Product Capacity Availability Timing Requirement
brief_description: Establish Product Capacity Availability Timing Requirement business activity identify scheduling needs for product capacity changes.
extended_description: Establish Product Capacity Availability Timing Requirement business activity identify scheduling needs for product capacity changes.

name: Implement Product Capacity Plan
brief_description: Implement Product Capacity Plan business activity is in charge of putting into effect the steps needed to achieve Product Capacity plans, with required product capacity, and product capacity management course of action.
extended_description: Implement Product Capacity Plan business activity is in charge of putting into effect the steps needed to achieve Product Capacity plans, with required product capacity, and product capacity management course of action.

name: Specify Required Product Capacity
brief_description: Specify Required Product Capacity business activity is in charge of implementing product capacity plans by identifying clearly and definitely product capacity expectations.
extended_description: Specify Required Product Capacity business activity is in charge of implementing product capacity plans by identifying clearly and definitely product capacity expectations.

name: Specify Product Capacity Course of Action
brief_description: Specify Product Capacity Course of Action business activity identifies clearly and definitely sequence of activities that must be followed to meet 'product capacity plan' expectations.
extended_description: Specify Product Capacity Course of Action business activity identifies clearly and definitely sequence of activities that must be followed to meet 'product capacity plan' expectations.

name: Analyze Product Capacity
brief_description: Analyze Product Capacity business activity establishes and models insights, patterns and changes to product capacity, by assessing potential capacity and the actual capacity a product currently achieves.
extended_description:
Analyze Product Capacity business activity establishes and models insights, patterns and changes to product capacity, by assessing potential capacity and the actual capacity a product currently achieves.

This business activity covers collection of product-related data (usage data, performance data, operational data etc.) to support Product Managers to identify patterns and insights relating to a product.

Analyze Product Capacity support Product Capacity Management by providing relevant and timely insights, including available inventory holding capacity, products "time and material" capacity, etc. and how capacity utilization (allocated, in-use, unused) can be optimized to increase business value.

name: Identify Product Capacity Optimization Need
brief_description: Identify Product Capacity Optimization Need business activity establish the best, or most effective, use of product capacity.
extended_description: Identify Product Capacity Optimization Need business activity establish the best, or most effective, use of product capacity.

name: Assess Available Product Capacity
brief_description: Assess Available Product Capacity business activity evaluates unused product capacity in relation to product capacity plans, and product utilization trends.
extended_description: Assess Available Product Capacity business activity evaluates unused product capacity in relation to product capacity plans, and product utilization trends.

name: Model Product Capacity
brief_description: Model Product Capacity business activity establishes a representation of Product Capacity based on business defined properties.
extended_description: Model Product Capacity business activity establishes a representation of Product Capacity based on business defined properties.

name: Establish Product Capacity Utilization Behavior
brief_description: Establish Product Capacity Utilization Behavior business activity develops Product Capacity usage models.
extended_description: Establish Product Capacity Utilization Behavior business activity develops Product Capacity usage models.

name: Perform Product Capacity and Capacity Demand Trend Analysis
brief_description: Perform Product Capacity and Capacity Demand Trend Analysis business activity analysis trends between available product capacity and product capacity demand according to business and usage.
extended_description: Perform Product Capacity and Capacity Demand Trend Analysis business activity analysis trends between available product capacity and product capacity demand according to business and usage.

name: Optimize Product Capacity
brief_description: Optimize Product Capacity business activity enable improve Product use by managing underlying and related dependencies and constraints.
extended_description:
Optimize Product Capacity business activity enable improve Product use by managing underlying and related dependencies and constraints.
For Product Capacity Management, Optimize Product Capacity can enable reclaim unused Product capacity, allocate additional capacity just in time to meet demand, repurpose products based on capacity utilization patterns and support configuration management of constraints and dependencies.

name: Manage Product Capacity Utilization
brief_description: Manage Product Capacity Utilization business activity is in charge of fulfilling and assuring the effective use of product capacity.
extended_description: Manage Product Capacity Utilization business activity is in charge of fulfilling and assuring the effective use of product capacity.

name: Adjust Product Capacity
brief_description: Adjust Product Capacity business activity, fulfill changes to Product Capacity.
extended_description: Adjust Product Capacity business activity, fulfill changes to Product Capacity.

name: Allocate Product Capacity
brief_description: Allocate Product Capacity business activity assign the amount in capacity that a product can support.
extended_description: Allocate Product Capacity business activity assign the amount in capacity that a product can support.

name: Manage Product Capacity Thresholds
brief_description: Manage Product Capacity Thresholds business activity is in charge administering product capacity thresholds based on conditions that are bounded by operational concerns.
extended_description: Manage Product Capacity Thresholds business activity is in charge administering product capacity thresholds based on conditions that are bounded by operational concerns.

name: Monitor Product Capacity
brief_description: Monitor Product Capacity business activity identifies relevant Product Capacity attributes to track, and tracks all attributes, their use, and changes.
extended_description:
Monitor Product Capacity business activity identifies relevant Product Capacity attributes to track, and tracks all attributes, their use, and changes.
Monitor Product Capacity supports all activities of Product Capacity Management by providing timely visibility for all concerns around Product Capacity.

name: Report Product Capacity
brief_description: Report Product Capacity business activity prepare and present detailed accounts on all relevant Product Capacity information, as deemed timely, relevant and reliable for use by business functions.
extended_description:
Report Product Capacity business activity prepare and present detailed accounts on all relevant Product Capacity information, as deemed timely, relevant and reliable for use by business functions.
Different business functions with interest for Product Capacity may require specific reports with specific information. This business activity ensures Report Product Capacity business activity ensures information on Product Capacity is collated, organized and presented in forms useful and reliable to the needs of business functions in a timely manner.

name: Product Inventory Management
brief_description: Product Inventory Management is responsible to establish, manage and administer the enterprise's product inventory, as embodied in the Product Inventory repository and monitor and report on the usage and access to the product inventory.

name: Identify Relevant Product Inventory Information
brief_description: Identifying the inventory-relevant information requirements to be captured for products.

name: Maintain Product Inventory facilities
brief_description: Identifying, establishing and maintaining product inventory repository facilities.

name: Control Product Inventory Access
brief_description: Managing the registration and access control processes that enable processes to create, update and/or look up product information to and from the product inventory.

name: Ensure Product Inventory Quality
brief_description: Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and quality of data maintained in the product inventory repository.
extended_description: Ensuring the product inventory repository accurately captures and records all identified product details, through use of automated or manual audits. Monitoring and reporting on the quality of the information maintained in the inventory. The product inventory maintains records of all products, their interactions with the enterprise, and any other product related- information, required to support CRM and other processes. The product inventory is also responsible for maintaining the association between customers and purchased product instances, created as a result of the Order Handling processes.

name: Track Product Inventory Usage
brief_description: Tracking and monitoring of the usage of, and access to, the product inventory repository and associated costs, and reporting on the findings.

name: Identify Product Inventory Shortcomings
brief_description: Identifying any technical driven shortcomings of the product inventory repository, and providing input to Resource Development & Management processes to rectify these issues.

name: Product Lifecycle Management Support
brief_description: Support the management of the lifecycle of a product and pricing associated with a product in the Product Inventory.
extended_description:
Product Lifecycle Management Support supports the management of the lifecycle of a product and pricing associated with a product.
It can create a product, specify the involvement one or more parties have with it, updates information about the product including the status and relationships with Product Specification, Product Offering, Account and all related roles.

The lifecycle of a product also includes prices associated with it which are also managed by this process.

name: Product Lifecycle Administration Support
brief_description: Create a product, specify the involvement one or more parties have with it, update information about the product, and remove the product when it is no longer of interest to an enterprise and/or the primary party responsible for the product at request from Operations processes.
extended_description:
Product Lifecycle Administration Support creates a product, specifies the involvement one or more parties have with it, updates information about the product including the status and relationships with Product Specification, Product Offering, Customer Account and all related roles at request from Operations processes.

Involvement may include the party account responsible for paying for the purchase and other charges, the party primarily responsible for the product, as well as users of the product.

Updates may include adding new products to a bundle as well as the location of the product.

name: Create Product
brief_description: Create a product as a standalone product or one that is part of a product bundle.
extended_description:
Create Product creates a product as a standalone product, a product bundle, or one that is part of a product bundle. The product is associated with either the product specification or product offering that describes it. If the product is one that is customized by a party and not offered by an enterprise the product is associated to the product specification that describes it.

Features/properties chosen during the Product Offering Purchasing process or chosen by this process if the product is created outside of the Product Offering Purchasing process may also be created for the product. This is done if the Product Configuration process is not used to create them.

A product is associated with its installation location if applicable and the associated product offering terms/conditions that were accepted, such as those for a contract or voucher. It may also be associated with one or more other products. For example, one product may replace another.

name: Specify Party Product Involvement
brief_description: Specify the involvement one or more parties have with a product, the parties' types of involvement, as well as identity specific information for users.
extended_description:
Specify Party Product Involvement specifies the involvement one or more parties have with it and the party account that will pay for the product. If the product is paid for when it is purchased and there are no recurring or other types of charges due at some point in the future, then the party account may not be specified. Involved parties type of involvement is also specified, such as user, owner, payer.

Additionally identity specific information, such as rights and restrictions, are specified for users (parties) of the product.

This process also updates and removes the involvement and identity specific information.

name: Modify Product
brief_description: Update product information, such as features/properties and the associated location. Features/properties may also be removed.

name: Product Pricing
brief_description: Apply, update, and remove a price associated with a product.
extended_description:
Product Pricing applies, updates a price associated with a product. A price may be applied when a party is browsing an enterprise's catalog (a form of window shopping that is supported by the Product Offering Purchase Lifecycle Management process), when configuring a product, or when purchasing a product offering.

The price may be what is paid when it is purchased or other types of charges due at some point in the future, such as recurring and usage based charges that are determined by a product's price.

name: Apply Product Price
brief_description: Apply a product price to a product. The price may be influenced directly or indirectly by a policy.
extended_description:
Apply Product Price applies a product price to a product. The price may be influenced directly or indirectly by a policy. A price may be a single price, a group of prices, or part of the group. For example, a group may consist of a recurring payment for base usage of the product, such as the number of times medical information can be sent to a doctor each month, and another price for any usage that exceeds the base.

The price may also be dependent on a policy or a policy may determine another price to apply to the product or some other product. For example, viewing more than a defined number of videos may result in a free view for a family member. Policies are defined when the product offering is developed and associated with an item on a product offering purchase.

name: Update Product Price
brief_description: Make changes to the price of a product.
extended_description: Update Product Price makes changes to the price of a product. The update may include changes to associations with a policy that influences the price. This is typically triggered by changes to the price of a product offering in an enterprise's product catalog.

name: Product Usage Management
brief_description: Encompasses the functions required to guide, distribute, mediate, summarize, accumulate, and analyze Product Usage records.
extended_description:
The Product Usage management processes encompass the functions required to guide, distribute, mediate, summarize, accumulate, and analyze Product Usage records. These processes may occur in real-time, near real-time (i.e. just at the end of the usage), or may be executed on a periodic basis.


Based on Service Usage, this process aims at identifying Product Usage. For example, for a Video on Demand where you can watch a video as many time as you want during 72 hours, several Service Usages might have been tracked (each time the user watches the video) and only one Product Usage will be identified for all Service Usages in the 72 hours after the first watch.

The guiding processes ensures that the Product Usage records used in the billing processes are appropriately related to the correct customer billing account and products.

The Product Usage records are edited and if necessary reformatted (mediated) to meet the needs of subsequent processes. The billing event records may also be enriched with additional data during this process.

name: Enrich Product Usages
brief_description: Enrich product usage records with additional data.
extended_description: The Enrich Product Usages processes will augment the product usage records by adding data to the records from sources such as customer, product,  or other reference data.

name: Add Product Usage Data
brief_description: Add data to the records from sources such as customer, product, or other reference data to augment the product usage records.

name: Assign Product Usage Price
brief_description: Assign a price to product usage without consideration of specific product or customer information. The assigned price may be used to enrich the product usage record.

name: Guide and Assign Product Usages
brief_description: Ensures that the product usage records used in the billing processes are related to the correct customer billing account and subscribed products.
extended_description:
The Guide Product Usages processes ensure that the event records used in the billing process relate to the correct customer billing account and products.  A specific product usage record may be related to multiple customer billing accounts and subscribed products.

Distribution of product usage records to other processes may also occur.

name: Assign Product Usages
brief_description: Ensure that the Product Usages used in the billing process relate to the correct Product.

name: Distribute Product Usage
brief_description: Distribute billing event records to other processes.

name: Guide Product Usages
brief_description: Guide Product Usages process is in charge of identifying Product Usages based on Service Usages.
extended_description:
Guide Product Usages process is in charge of identifying Product Usages based on Service Usages.
For example, for a Video on Demand where you can watch a video as many time as you want during 72 hours, several Service Usages might have been tracked (each time the user watches the video) and only one Product Usage will be identified for all Service Usages in the 72 hours after the first watch.

name: Mediate Product Usages
brief_description: Edits and reformats data for recipient applications.
extended_description: The Mediate Product Usages process edits and reformats the data record to meet the needs of a recipient application.

name: Edit Product Usages
brief_description: Edit the data record for recipient applications.

name: Reformat Product Usages
brief_description: Reformat the data record for recipient applications.

name: Report Product Usage Records
brief_description: Generate reports on product usage records based on requests from other processes.
extended_description:
The purpose of the Report Product Usage Record processes is to generate reports on Product Usage records based on requests from other processes.
These processes produce reports that may identify abnormalities, which may be caused by fraudulent activity or related to customer complaints.
Investigation of problems related to these product usage records is also part of this process.

These processes also support other processes such as customer review of product usages (pre-billing and post-billing).

name: Generate Product Usage Report
brief_description: Generate reports on product usage records based on requests from other processes.

name: Investigate Product Usage Related Problem
brief_description: Investigate problems related to product usage records.

name: Support Product Usage Related Process
brief_description: Support other processes such as customer review of product usages (pre-billing and post-billing).

name: Product Rating & Rate Assignment
brief_description: Rate a value (monetary or other) to a Product Usage or a set of Product Usages and assign the result to a Product and a Billing Account.
extended_description:
The purpose of Product Rating & Assignment is to rate a value (monetary or other) to Product Usage or a set of Product Usages and assign the result to a Product and a Billing Account. The charge may be either a credit or a debit and can be handled either online or offline.

Online charging is performed in real-time, requiring an authorization component which may affect how the service is rendered and enables an operator to provide prepaid services to its customers. Whereas offline charging is performed after the service is rendered and is not required to be done in real-time and generally relates to subscription based products.

name: Perform Rating
brief_description: Calculating the value of a product usage or a set of product usages, before, during or after the rendering of the service.
extended_description: Process responsible for calculating the value of a product usage or a set of product usages, before, during or after the rendering of the service, based on parameters of the request (type, quantity, etc.), parameters of the customer/subscriber (tariffs, price plans, accumulated usage, contracts, etc.) and other parameters (time-of-day, taxes, etc.). The same request maybe rated differently for different subscribers based on their purchased offers or agreements.

name: Aggregate Items For Rate Assignment
brief_description: Manages the accumulation of items that may be used in the selection of a value or in calculation of a rate/discount.
extended_description: This process is responsible for accumulating contributing items, which can be quantities, values (monetary or other) or both. Aggregation can occur over time or can be initiated to gather a “snapshot” of the items at a point in time.

name: Manage Customer Assignment Hierarchy
brief_description: Managing the charging relationships among subscribers.
extended_description: Customer hierarchies are commonly used for corporate customers, family plans or other type of affinity groups. This process manages the assignment relationships among subscribers, e.g. sharing, inheriting or restricting balances, price plans and discounts. Thereby assuring that a charge is added to or subtracted from the correct account balance.

name: Provide Advice of Rate
brief_description: Provide advice of rate.
extended_description: The activity of Provide Advice of Rate (aka Advice of Charge) is responsible for providing advice on rates, in real-time or offline, an estimate or value of the rate for a specific usage request. The advice is usually based upon performing a full rating process for the request.

name: Apply Rate Level Discounts
brief_description: Applies discounts to product prices.
extended_description:
This process applies discounts to product prices at an individual product level. A discount may be expressed as a monetary amount or percentage, and modifies a price for a product. When a discount is expressed as a percentage, the discounting process determines the discount calculated in relation to the price for the product.

The discount may be displayed as a separate entry on the bill or may be combined with the rate for the product to only show as one entry.

Discounts may be a one-time event or may have some duration (days, months, life of product, etc.). Discounts may apply to a specific customer or be generally available based on selection of products (for example - bundles). Discounting structures may involve tiers, tapers, or thresholds.

name: Product Balance Management
brief_description: Management of  Product balances.
extended_description:
This process is responsible for holding, calculating, applying policies and managing functionality/interfaces for the Product balances

Here the values resulting from rating and the application of discounts are applied to a Product balance. The balance affected by the value may be monetary or other balances such as minutes, points, or tokens. Authorizing service requests based on available balance is optional.

name: Manage Product Balance Containers
brief_description: Hold and maintain the different Product balances that a customer and/or a subscriber may have.
extended_description:
This process manages the balance containers assigned to a Product and is used to keep track of usage events, providing input for decision making processes (such as product usage authorization) by means of the balance policies.

The containers include monetary and non-monetary balances (or shared) and are used as prepaid balances (enabling real-time product usage authorization), postpaid balances (in conjunction with an Account-Receivables [AR] application). Examples of non-monetary balances and allowances are: free minutes, WAP-only quota, etc.

name: Manage Product Balance Policies
brief_description: Executing policies per balance or balance type.
extended_description:
Product Balance policies are rules that describe how balance affecting usages are to be handled.  This is done  by comparing the value of each usage against criteria such as the following:
- a minimum allowable balance limit (e.g. balance must remain above zero),
- balance expiration dates,
- balance thresholds actions and notifications and
- roll-over & cyclic policies.

name: Product Balance Operations Management
brief_description: Allow different operations to be performed on the managed balance.
extended_description:
Product Balance operations processes the charged events, using balance policies and then guides the results towards the relevant balance containers. Operations include :
- Reserving amounts from any balance for any session, and crediting unused reservations back into the balance, when a session is released.
- Updating balances by applying charges to the balance and credit/debit adjustments.
- Balance queries.
- Transferring amounts from one balance to another.

name: Authorize Transaction Based on Product Balance
brief_description: Manages authorization of product usage requests based on available balances (monetary or non-monetary) and policies.
extended_description:
This process may include Product balance reservation and must be performed online.
Subsequent balance updates are not required to be done in real-time. In this context a usage is provided by the network, e.g. voice call. Product might be a digital content delivered via the network, e.g. content such as music, games, etc.

name: Product Catalog Planning Management
brief_description: Product Catalog Planning Management business process covers a set of business activities that understand and enable establish the plan to define, design and operationalize a catalog in order to meet the needs and objectives of Product cataloging.
extended_description:
Product Catalog Planning Management business process covers a set of business activities that understand and enable establish the plan to define, design and operationalize a catalog in order to meet the needs and objectives of Product cataloging.
The Product Catalog Planning Management business process ensure that the organization is able to identify the most appropriate scheme and goal for it catalog. It includes designing the Catalog plan and developing the specification according to Product management requirement.

name: Design Product Catalog Plan
brief_description: Design Catalog Plan business activity understands requirements and capabilities demanded from the business to establish the Catalog plan based on the Product strategy for Product Catalog Planning Management.
extended_description: Product Design Catalog Plan business activity understands requirements and capabilities demanded from the business to establish the Catalog plan based on the Product strategy for Product Catalog Planning Management.

name: Define Product Catalog Specification
brief_description: Define Catalog Specification business activity establishes the Catalog specifications based on the product/service/resource strategy to support Catalog Planning Management.
extended_description:
Define Catalog Specification business activity establishes the Catalog specifications based on the product/service/resource strategy to support Catalog Planning Management.
Define Catalog Specification leverages Specification Management business activities to establish the mandatory and optional design requirements, as well as catalog entry fields according to product/service/resource management needs. This process will be governed by the Enterprise Business Process for Catalog Management.

name: Product Catalog Lifecycle Management
brief_description: Catalog Lifecycle Management business process covers a set of business activities that enable manage the lifecycle of an organizations catalog from design to build according to defined requirements.
extended_description:
Catalog Lifecycle Management business process covers a set of business activities that enable manage the lifecycle of an organizations catalog from design to build according to defined requirements.
Catalog Lifecycle Management proves the overarching governance to manage all the stages in the realization and operationalization of the Product/Service/Resource Catalog in support of the organizations business goals.

name: Manage Product Catalog Design
brief_description: Manage Catalog Design business activity cover the design of the Catalog in accordance to the Catalog Management Lifecycle.
extended_description:
Manage Catalog Design business activity cover the design of the Catalog in accordance to the Catalog Management Lifecycle.
Manage Catalog Design business activity will leverage Catalog Specification requirement for all information (features, attributes etc.) to be managed by the catalog in order to enable support the Catalog Lifecycle Management.

name: Manage Product Catalog Build
brief_description: Manage Catalog Design business activity covers the design of the Catalog in accordance to the Catalog Management Lifecycle.
extended_description:
Manage Catalog Design business activity covers the design of the Catalog in accordance to the Catalog Management Lifecycle.
This business activity leverages input from the Catalog Design to construct the product/service/resource Catalog in order to meet the business operations goals.

name: Manage Product Catalog Policy
brief_description: Manage Catalog Build business activity establishes, manages and administers the governing of the catalog for operations readiness and operations.
extended_description:
Manage Catalog Build business activity establishes, manages and administers the governing of the catalog for operations readiness and operations.
This business activity leverages support of the Enterprise governance processes for product/service/resource catalog lifecycle management.

name: Product Catalog Operational Readiness Management
brief_description: Product Catalog Operational Readiness Management business process establishes and administers the support needed to operationalize Product catalogs for ongoing day-to-day business needs.
extended_description:
Product Catalog Operational Readiness Management business process establishes and administers the support needed to operationalize Product catalogs for ongoing day-to-day business needs.
These business activities implement the Product Catalog through Release and Deploy business activities.
Release Product Catalog business activity ensure all cross-functional activities needed to support catalog maintenance and operations, such as training and updating the support of the catalog are in place.
Release Product Catalog business activity includes identifying stakeholders, catalog integration, catalog federation etc. for any scenario in support of the organizations business goals, including Release conditions that support users, customers and business partners.

name: Release Product Catalog
brief_description: Release Product Catalog business activity ensure all cross-functional activities needed to support catalog maintenance and operations, such as training and updating the support of the catalog are in place.
extended_description:
Release Product Catalog business activity ensure all cross-functional activities needed to support catalog maintenance and operations, such as training and updating the support of the catalog are in place.
Release Product Catalog business activity includes identifying stakeholders, catalog integration, catalog federation etc. for any scenario in support of the organizations business goals, including Release conditions that support users, customers and business partners.

name: Plan & Schedule Product Catalog Release
brief_description: Plan & Schedule Product Catalog Release business activity is used to handle the release plan for the Product Catalog.
extended_description: Plan & Schedule Product Catalog Release business activity is used to handle the release plan for the Product Catalog.

name: Control Product Catalog Release
brief_description: Control Product Catalog Release business activity is used to support the various catalog release tasks.
extended_description: Control Product Catalog Release business activity is used to support the various catalog release tasks.

name: Test Product Catalog
brief_description: Test Product Catalog business activity is used to establish the quality, reliability and performance requirement of the catalog according to the Product management needs.
extended_description: Test Product Catalog business activity is used to establish the quality, reliability and performance requirement of the catalog according to the Product management needs.

name: Deploy Product Catalog
brief_description: Deploy Product Catalog business activity manage the availability and use of the Product catalog in operations.
extended_description:
Deploy Product Catalog business activity manage the availability and use of the Product catalog in operations.
Deploy Product Catalog business activity includes identifying stakeholders, creating catalog category hierarchies, catalog integration, and catalog federation for any scenario, such as with business partners and between business functions.

name: Product Catalog Content Management
brief_description: Product Catalog Content Management business process define and provide the business activities that support the day-to-day operations of Product Catalogs in order to realize the business operations goals.
extended_description:
Product Catalog Content Management business process define and provide the business activities that support the day-to-day operations of Product Catalogs in order to realize the business operations goals.
Product Catalog Content Management business processes include administering the Product Catalog instance in production, maintaining catalog entries, assuring catalogs, managing catalog access, managing entry lifecycle through versioning, handling catalog entity entry and changes, supporting distribution of catalogs as needed, and supporting user-facing activities.

name: Maintain Product Catalog Content
brief_description: Maintain Product Catalog Content business activity handles catalog content entry for adding or updating the operational Catalog by following the established Catalog Content Management operations standards and policies.
extended_description:
Maintain Product Catalog Content business activity handles catalog content entry through adding or updating the Catalog by following the established Catalog Content Management standards and policies.
Manage Catalog Entry support the following activities and sub-activities:
Maintaining Catalog Content Versions
Maintain Catalog Content Relationship
Maintain Catalog Content taxonomy
Organize Catalog Entry
Classify Catalog Entry

name: Maintain Product Catalog Content Version
brief_description: Maintain Product Catalog Content Version business activity handles tracking and controlling changes for Product catalog entries.
extended_description: Maintain Product Catalog Content Version business activity handles tracking and controlling changes for Product catalog entries.

name: Maintain Product Catalog Content Relationship
brief_description: Maintain Product Catalog Content Relationship business activity handles associating Product catalog entries.
extended_description:
Maintain Product Catalog Content Relationship business activity handles associating Product catalog entries.
Catalog Content Relationship for Product catalog entries can be internal and external to the Product, Service or Resource domains.

name: Maintain Product Catalog Content Entry
brief_description: Maintain Product Catalog Content Entry business activity handles content entry, content organization, content classification in the Product Catalog according to the Product Catalog model.
extended_description: Maintain Product Catalog Content Entry business activity handles content entry, content organization, content classification in the Product Catalog according to the Product Catalog model.

name: Organize Product Catalog Content Entry
brief_description: Organize Product Catalog Content Entry business activity handles Catalog Content organization according to the Product Catalog model.
extended_description:
Organize Product Catalog Content Entry business activity handles Catalog Content organization according to the Product Catalog model.
Organize Catalog Content Entry business activities can include ordering, arranging, sorting, assembling, and grouping.

name: Classify Product Catalog Content Entry
brief_description: Classify Product Catalog Content Entry business activity specifically handles Catalog Content organization according to business classification characteristics for the Product Catalog.
extended_description:
Classify Product Catalog Content Entry business activity specifically handles Catalog Content organization according to business classification characteristics for the Product Catalog.
Classify Product Catalog Content Entry is specific to shared qualities or characteristics defined by the organization.

name: Manage Product Catalog Access
brief_description: Manage Product Catalog Access business activity handles access to the catalog according to the Catalog Content Management standards and policies.
extended_description:
Manage Product Catalog Access business activity handles access to the catalog according to the Catalog Content Management standards and policies.
Manage Product Catalog Access will handle assigning catalog managers and granting privileges.

name: Manage Product Catalog Content Lifecycle
brief_description: Manage Product Catalog Content Lifecycle business activity handles changes to catalog content according to the Catalog Content Management standards and policies.
extended_description: Manage Product Catalog Content Lifecycle business activity handles changes to catalog content according to the Catalog Content Management standards and policies.

name: Distribute Product Catalog
brief_description: Distribute Product Catalog business activity handles exchange and distribution of catalogs according to the Catalog Content Management standards and policies.
extended_description: Distribute Product Catalog business activity handles exchange and distribution of catalogs according to the Catalog Content Management standards and policies.

name: Product Specification Management
brief_description: Product Specification Management business process leverages captured product requirements to develop, master, analyze, and update documented standard and personalized conditions that must be satisfied by product design and/or delivery.
extended_description:
Product Specification Management business process leverages captured product requirements to develop, master, analyze, and update documented standard and personalized conditions that must be satisfied by product design and/or delivery.
Product Specifications Management can result in establishing, in a centralized way, technical (know-how) standards for products. Such standards provide the organization with a means to control and approve the values and inputs of product specification through structure, review, approval and distribution processes to users (including customers and business partners).

name: Describe Product Specifications
brief_description: Describe Product Specifications business activity identify and elaborate on the conditions for meeting product requirement in order to support assuring consistency, quality, functionality and fit for purpose products.
extended_description:
Describe Product Specifications business activity identify and elaborate on the conditions for meeting product requirement in order to support assuring consistency, quality, functionality and fit for purpose products.
Describing Product Specification can leverage captured product requirements and product preferences to build in tolerances for changes according to users of the products.

name: Describe Product Specifications Property
brief_description: Describe Product Specifications Property set out and develop the rules, constraints, models and the sets of principles on which the product specification can be modelled according to business and user requirements.
extended_description: Product Specification Property enumerate all the product specification attributes and their units, and documents requirements that provides product teams the information they need to build out or enhance features or functionality of products.

name: Align Product Specifications
brief_description: Align Product Specifications business activity handle the alignment, relationships and linkages of product specification to functional and non-functional requirement.
extended_description:
Align Product Specifications business activity handle the alignment, relationships and linkages of product specification to functional and non-functional requirement.
The alignment of product specifications can be to other products as well as realization of the specific services and resource according to business objectives (e.g. cost, other accounting and non-accounting requirements etc.).

name: Model Product Specifications
brief_description:
Model Product Specification business activity is in charge of determining independent product specifications variables to include and exclude from asserting the product specifications relationships and connections.

The need for modelling product specifications often begins when a product manager seeks to define the relationship between independent product variables and the dependent product variable.
extended_description:
Model Product Specification business activity is in charge of determining independent product specifications variables to include and exclude from asserting the product's specification relationships and connections.

The need for modelling product specifications often begins when a product manager seeks to define the relationship between independent product variables and the dependent product variable.
This business activity is used by organizations to establish and manage the collection of standardized, pre-documented product specifications and their dependencies to guide Lifecycle Management and Operations.

name: Analyze Product Specifications
brief_description: Analyze Product Specifications business activity research, assess and evaluate performance criteria and factors to develop, master, control and update in products specifications, according to ongoing requirements.
extended_description:
Analyze Product Specifications business activity research, assess and evaluate performance criteria and factors to develop, master, control and update in products specifications, according to ongoing requirements.
This business activity can include multiple analyzes of product specifications, including standard analysis (based on empirical research) or custom analysis (based on other standards). Analysis of Service Specification include testing product specifications, and the ability to meet business requirements, as well as conformance to operational mandates.

name: Update and Version Product Specifications
brief_description: Update Product Specification business activity updates, tracks and versions changes to existing product specifications according to versioning policies to support product requirement management and product's operational activities.
extended_description:
Update Product Specification business activity updates, tracks and versions changes to existing product specifications according to versioning policies to support product requirement management and product's operational activities.
This business activity manages all changes to product specifications over their lifecycle. As part of this business activity, Product Specification versioning is a sub-activity which ensures communicating changes to product specifications, so that product planners and consumers know what to expect. It includes communicating when changes are made to product specification properties.

name: Product Anomaly Lifecycle Management
brief_description: Product Anomaly Lifecycle Management business process establishes and controls all activities that are involved in overseeing, directing, administering, controlling and organizing the definition, detection/prediction, mitigation and learnings related to P
extended_description:
Product Anomaly Lifecycle Management business process establishes and controls all activities that are involved in overseeing, directing, administering, controlling and organizing the definition, detection/prediction, mitigation and learnings related to Product Anomaly Management.
Product Anomaly Lifecycle Management cover the lifecycle activities, including:
Establishing “what is normal” for a active product (buy, sell, care) in order to inform “deviations” or aberrations.
Orchestrating Product Anomaly Management activities to meet customer and business partner needs.
Managing the ability to acquire and apply knowledge and skills from past and present product anomalies.
Managing actions that make the best or effective use of Product Management Closed Loops.
Monitoring feedback to and from Product Management to support Product Anomaly Management activities.
Reporting on Product Anomaly Management Closed Loops.

name: Manage Product Anomaly Definition
brief_description: Manage Product Anomaly Definition business activity is in charge of defining and describing the information about data which is used in Product Anomaly Management.
extended_description:
Manage Product Anomaly Definition business activity is in charge of defining and describing the information about data which is used in Product Anomaly Management.
Product Manage Anomaly Definition business activity covers activities that describe the criteria, characteristics, and expectations of information required for Product Anomaly Detection. Any descriptions and definitions of the information about data use in Product Anomaly Management business activities may include, but not be limited to "normal pattern data", "constraints data", "goals data" etc.

name: Define Product Anomaly Closed Loop
brief_description: Define Product Anomaly Closed Loop business activity state and describe the Product Anomaly Closed Loops along with associated information that lead to identifying, detecting or predicting a Product Anomaly.
extended_description:
Define Product Anomaly Closed Loop business activity state and describe the Product Anomaly Closed Loops along with associated information that lead to identifying, detecting or predicting a Product Anomaly.
This business activity supports Anomaly definition process and the Closed Loops associated, including all associated inputs that reasonably affect the management of an Anomaly Lifecycle. This activity also ensures that the organization understands, and has well-defined operational workflows underpinning Anomaly Management.

name: Establish Product Anomaly Closed Loop Information Sources
brief_description: Establish Product Anomaly Closed Loop Information Sources business activity identifies all information sources and the requisite data that must be managed to support Product Anomaly Management Closed Loops.
extended_description:
Establish Product Anomaly Closed Loop Information Sources business activity identifies all information sources and the requisite data that must be managed to support Product Anomaly Management Closed Loops.
Establish Product Anomaly Closed Loop Information Sources help to identify the information (not limited to business and operations rules), business logic, levels of classification (by importance, by period etc.), impact and urgency etc. that can help detect Product Anomaly. This process supports Product Anomaly Management during day-to-day operations.

name: Orchestrate Product Anomaly Management Closed Loop
brief_description: Orchestrate Product Anomaly Management Closed Loop business activity is in charge of organizing, arranging and coordinating changes that control Product Anomaly Closed Loops.
extended_description:
Orchestrate Product Anomaly Management Closed Loop business activity is in charge of organizing, arranging and coordinating changes that control Product Anomaly Closed Loops.
This business activity will cover:
Managing Product Anomaly Detection activities - initiating, suspending, maintaining, and terminating.
Organizing Product Anomaly Detection activities - including arranging the sequence for Closed Loop activities.
Coordinating changes to a Product Anomaly Management Closed Loop.

name: Manage Product Anomaly Profile
brief_description: Manage Product Anomaly Profile business activity is in charge of recording and analyzing Product Anomaly Management frameworks in order to enable assess and predict Anomaly Management capabilities according to well-specified models.
extended_description:
Manage Product Anomaly Profile business activity is in charge of recording and analyzing Product Anomaly Management frameworks in order to enable assess and predict Anomaly Management capabilities according to well-specified models.
Manage Product Anomaly Profile supports Product Anomaly Management operations, as well as capturing the business intents that need to be associated with Product Anomaly Closed Loops and Product Anomaly Management Lifecycle.

name: Monitor Product Anomaly Management Closed Loop
brief_description: Monitor Product Anomaly Management Closed Loop business activity provides the capability to observe Product Anomaly Management Closed Loops.
extended_description:
Monitor Product Anomaly Management Closed Loop business activity provides the capability to observe Product Anomaly Management Closed Loops.
This business activity helps to scan; watch; monitor; gain awareness of Product Anomaly Management activities that close the loop in an Product Anomaly Management Lifecycle(s).

name: Report Product Anomaly Management Closed Loop
brief_description: Report Product Anomaly Management Closed Loop business activity documents information organized to deliver an account of any, and all Product Anomaly Closed Loops.
extended_description:
Report Product Anomaly Management Closed Loop business activity documents information organized to deliver an account of any, and all Product Anomaly Closed Loops.
Anomaly Closed Loops may fall into either or across any of the four stages in any of the overarching Closed Loop pattern - Observe, Orient, Decide and Act - or other variations.

name: Manage Product Anomaly Intelligence
brief_description: Manage Product Anomaly Intelligence business activity is in charge of acquiring and applying new learning, knowledge and skills to Product Anomaly Management.
extended_description:
Manage Product Anomaly Intelligence business activity is in charge of acquiring and applying new learning, knowledge and skills to Product Anomaly Management.
This business activity supports improving, optimizing, or evolving Product Anomaly Management activities. Manage Product Anomaly Intelligence helps to incorporate new knowledge and skills into Product Anomaly Management processes. This is as well to enable improvement and optimization of Anomaly Management in a continuum.

name: Manage Product Anomaly Optimization
brief_description: Manage Product Anomaly Optimization business activity is in charge of actions that make the best and most effective use of Product Anomaly Management activities to improve Product Anomaly Management.
extended_description:
Manage Product Anomaly Optimization business activity is in charge of actions that make the best and most effective use of Product Anomaly Management activities to improve Product Anomaly Management.
Manage Product Anomaly Optimization business activity can manage the business logic and business rules associated with Product Anomaly Detection, Product Anomaly Assessment, Product Anomaly Forecasting and Prediction, Product Anomaly Mitigation, as well as underlying Product Knowledge Management.
This business activity also includes fine-tuning of business logic, operations logic, business and operations rules that improve efficiency of Anomaly Management as a whole.

name: Product Anomaly Management
brief_description: Product Anomaly Management business processes establish actions that predict and detect aberrations or outlier events/activities, assess them for their impact, mitigate them, and record them before they ever become product problem management concerns.
extended_description:
Product Anomaly Management business processes establish actions that predict and detect aberrations or outlier events/activities, assess them for their impact, mitigate them, and record them before they ever become product problem management concerns.
By establishing that an action or event is abnormal (based on known patterns), Product Anomaly Management helps to assess them through a set of activities that may triage, plan detailed assessment, classify them and provide  mitigatory actions for them. Through Product Anomaly Management, assurance of Products, based on abnormal events or activities can be well categorized, prioritized and actioned on. Product Anomaly Management is different from Product Problem Management as the later addresses known issues, faults or problems.

name: Predict Product Anomaly
brief_description: Predict Product Anomaly business activity is in charge of declaring or indicating in advance (or foretells on the basis of product buy-use-sell observation, product use experience or reason) upcoming exceptions, as well as trends that can lead to outlier activities / events or problems.
extended_description:
Predict Product Anomaly business activity is in charge of declaring or indicating in advance (or foretells on the basis of product buy-use-sell observation, product use experience or reason) upcoming exceptions, as well as trends that can lead to outlier activities / events or problems.
Product Anomaly Prediction business activity can help to detect and interpret early activities or events with their impending exceptions while suggesting causes.

name: Forecast Product Anomaly
brief_description: Forecast Product Anomaly business activity predicts future Product anomaly along with implications using historical, and /or ongoing patterns observed through exceptions.
extended_description:
Forecast Product Anomaly business activity predicts future Product anomaly along with implications using historical, and /or ongoing patterns observed through exceptions.
Forecast Product Anomaly business activity may include what-if analysis, or impact analysis of the anomalous exceptions. Forecast Product Anomaly business activity supports the identification of potential risks of an exception, and the course of action needed to avoid potential risks.

name: Detect Product Anomaly
brief_description: Detect Product Anomaly business activity identify Product (buy/use/care) activities that are a deviation (aberrations or abnormal actions/events) from well-define norms or expectations.
extended_description:
Detect Product Anomaly business activity identify Product (buy/use/care) activities that are a deviation (aberrations or abnormal actions/events) from well-define norms or expectations.
Product Anomaly Detection finds patterns in Product Management activities, as well as with engaged parties given a deviation from planned, or expected business objectives or goals.

name: Identify Product Exception
brief_description: Identify Product Exceptions business activity supports the detection of Product Anomaly by investigating (recognizing and establishing) particular activity or event as an exception.
extended_description:
Identify Product Exception business activity supports the detection of Product Anomaly by investigating (recognizing and establishing) particular activity or event as an exception.
Identify Product Exception business activity will support all Product Anomaly Management business activities - Assess Product Anomaly, Predict Product Anomaly, Mitigate Product Anomaly and Learn Product Anomaly.

name: Treat Product Exception
brief_description: Treat Product Exception business activity provides the set of actions that support managing a products’ anomalous exception.
extended_description:
Treat Product Exception business activity provides the set of actions that support managing a products’ anomalous exception.
This covers actions that may be:
Proactive: Where the treatment of the conditions leading from the exception are controlled;
Reactive: Where the treatment is directly in response to the exception.
Treat Product Exceptions business activity helps to outline a series of actions that can expedite decisions for mitigation.

name: Escalate Product Exceptions
brief_description: Escalate Product Exception business activity is in charge of increasing the attention given to handling of a Product Exception.
extended_description:
Escalate Product Exception business activity is in charge of increasing the attention given to handling of a Product Exception.
Escalating a Product’s exception may be based on several factors, including defined business rules of escalation, or the lack thereof for handling a product’s exception.

name: Assess Product Anomaly
brief_description: Assess Product Anomaly business activity check, estimate, appraise and evaluate Product anomaly observations to determine implications and follow-on treatment.
extended_description:
Assess Product Anomaly business activity check, estimate, appraise and evaluate Product anomaly observations to determine implications and follow-on treatment.
Assess Product Anomaly ensures that the business can ascertain understanding of a product’s anomalous activity, its extent/scale, cause and effect, and provide evidence-based information to develop courses of action.

name: Triage Product Exception
brief_description: Triage Product Exception business activity is in charge of identifying and assigning the degrees of urgency, and the order of treatment of products’ anomalous exceptions.
extended_description:
Triage Product Exception business activity is in charge of identifying and assigning the degrees of urgency, and the order of treatment of products’ anomalous exceptions.
Triage Product Exceptions sub activities may include prioritizing exceptions and underlying product anomaly events while examining causes that enable apply an initial set of mediatory actions.

name: Plan and Select Product Anomaly Assessment Criteria
brief_description: Plan and Select Product Anomaly Assessment Criteria business activity define the course of action to assess a product anomaly, along with organizing the product’s anomaly assessment criteria in order to best facilitate detection and mitigation of anomalies.
extended_description:
Plan and Select Product Anomaly Assessment Criteria business activity define the course of action to assess a product anomaly, along with organizing the product’s anomaly assessment criteria in order to best facilitate detection and mitigation of anomalies.
The 'Plan and Select Assessment Criteria' process helps the organization to optimize the approaches to assess product anomaly criteria in order to continually avoid impact of false positives and false negatives in the detection of product anomalies.

name: Analyze Product Anomalies to Learning
brief_description: Analyze Product Anomalies to Learning business activity establish actions to discover and correlate anomalous behavior to 'learned normal' or 'expected behavior'.
extended_description:
Analyze Product Anomalies to Learning business activity establish actions to discover and correlate anomalous behavior to 'learned normal' or 'expected behavior'.
Analyze Product Anomalies to Learning sub activities help to enrich the organization's Anomaly Detection activities altogether, which can result in a reduction in the time to detect, triage and treat product anomalies.

name: Classify Product Anomaly
brief_description: Classify Product Anomaly business activity establish ways to organize product anomalies into established categories according to business priorities and objectives.
extended_description:
Classify Product Anomaly business activity establish ways to organize product anomalies into established categories according to business priorities and product management objectives.
Classify Product Anomaly includes establishing robust classification models that help to triage anomalies, determine communication needs, determine and measure impact, and report on product anomalies.

name: Manage Product Anomaly Assessment Feedback Reporting
brief_description: Manage Product Anomaly Assessment Feedback Reporting business activity is in charge of establishing and handling the activities that prepare and report the feedback based of Product Anomaly Assessment activity.
extended_description:
Manage Product Anomaly Assessment Feedback Reporting business activity is in charge of establishing and handling the activities that prepare and report the feedback based of Product Anomaly Assessment activity.
Manage Product Anomaly Assessment Feedback business activity covers tasks that prepare and report feedback of an Anomaly Assessment activity. This business activity is also helpful in supporting the optimization of the Anomaly Detection business activity, such as fine-tuning know-how for product anomaly detection.
Reports generated from this business activity can be utilized for Product Anomaly Mitigation and can help to select the consequent actions required to mitigate a product anomaly.

name: Mitigate Product Anomaly
brief_description: Mitigate Product Anomaly business activity is in charge of allaying or alleviate the impact of a product’s anomalous exception.
extended_description:
Mitigate Product Anomaly business activity is in charge of allaying or alleviate the impact of a product’s anomalous exception.
Mitigate Product Anomaly identify and coordinate mitigatory actions required for product’s anomalous exceptions, including the initiation of remedial actions, and providing support to monitor and report on the mitigatory action.
Mitigate Product Anomaly can ensure the effect of a detected anomalous exception is minimized or resolved through appropriate actions. The aim of this business activity is to reduce Product Problem Management occurrence.

name: Identify Product Exception Mitigation
brief_description: Identify Product Exception Mitigation business activity helps to map product’s anomalous exceptions with actions that will reduce impact to business.
extended_description:
Identify Product Exception Mitigation business activity helps to map product’s anomalous exceptions with actions that will reduce impact to business.
Identifying product exception and their mitigatory action involves tasks that may leverage established business policies and constraints, and/or be based on knowledge and skills related to context.
This business activity helps to incorporate the right treatment based on the importance, impact or risk factors involved in a products operation. Any treatment of this nature can be static, based on pre-defined business rules, or dynamic based on skills and knowledge derived from context.

name: Coordinate Product Exception Mitigation
brief_description: Coordinate Product Exception Mitigation business activity is in charge of managing the different activities of an exception mitigation plan all together to successfully realize a mitigation plan.
extended_description: Coordinate Product Exception Mitigation business activity is in charge of managing the different activities of an exception mitigation plan all together to successfully realize a mitigation plan.

name: Initiate Product Exception Mitigation
brief_description: Initiate Product Exception Mitigation business activity is in charge of starting the correct activities that mitigate product anomaly exceptions, cognizant of business requirement and goals.
extended_description:
Initiate Product Exception Mitigation business activity is in charge of starting the correct activities that mitigate product anomaly exceptions, cognizant of business requirement and goals.
Initiate Product Exception Mitigation actions include recommendations for course of actions, fostering dynamic execution of actions, and/or scheduling actions based on predetermined business conditions and policies.

name: Monitor Product Exception Mitigation
brief_description: Monitor Product Exception Mitigation business activity is in charge of observing, checking and keeping a continuous records of mitigatory actions that support Product Anomaly Management.
extended_description:
Monitor Product Exception Mitigation business activity is in charge of  observing, checking and keeping a continuous records of mitigatory actions that support Product Anomaly Management.
Monitor Product Exception Mitigation covers the action and data that are involved (including collection and analysis on predefined set of information – e.g. KPIs etc.) in Product Anomaly Management business activities, tasks and workflows.

name: Report Product Exception Mitigation
brief_description: Report Product Exception Mitigation business activity is in charge of providing an account (documented or otherwise) of mitigatory actions taken to lessen or reduce the impact of a product anomaly.
extended_description:
Report Product Exception Mitigation business activity is in charge of providing an account (documented or otherwise) of mitigatory actions taken to lessen or reduce the impact of a product anomaly.
Reporting on Product Exception Mitigation may follow well-defined business and operations criteria, or predefined set of metrics (KPIs etc.) that are underlying to mitigate anomaly business activity.

name: Manage Product Anomaly Learning
brief_description: Manage Product Anomaly Learning business activity is in charge of capturing, or acquiring knowledge and skill related to handled anomalous exceptions (from detection, through assessment to mitigation).
extended_description:
Manage Product Anomaly Learning business activity is in charge of capturing, or acquiring knowledge and skill related to handled anomalous exceptions (from detection, through assessment to mitigation).
Manage Anomaly Learning business activity ensure that knowledge and skills gained from product anomalies can aide future Product Anomaly Management activities.

name: Manage Product Anomaly Case History
brief_description: Manage Product Anomaly Case History business activity records all past information on Product Anomaly events, Product Anomaly Management activities and data underlying, and representing Product Anomaly cases.
extended_description:
Manage Product Anomaly Case History business activity records all past information on Product Anomaly events, Product Anomaly Management activities and data underlying, and representing Product Anomaly cases.
Manage Product Anomaly Case History includes the maintenance of past and present records, all artifacts, knowledge-base (e.g. the specifications, profiles, exception patterns, action patterns etc.) and versioned information.
This business activity supports the organization to maintain skills and learning repository to identify and predict Anomalous Exception patterns and mitigatory actions.

name: Product Problem Management
brief_description: Product Problem Management process is in charge of directing and controlling activities that identify, triage, discover causes, report and close product problems (cases, issues, challenges and faults etc.).
extended_description:
Product Problem Management process is in charge of directing and controlling activities that identify, triage, discover causes, report and close product problems (cases, issues, challenges and faults etc.).

Product Problem Management ensures that products that are commercially offered by the organization can be assured to meet the goals and objectives of their design. The objective of this processes is to respond to product challenges/concerns/issues/cases and offer answers/resolution to them.

The goal of this process is mediate the impact, or resolve the concerns that impact Marketing and Sales objectives.

name: Identify Product Problem
brief_description: Identify Product Problem business activity is in charge of establishing a product case/concern/issues or challenge.
extended_description:
Identify Product Problem business activity is in charge of establishing a product case/concern/issues or challenge.

Identify Product Problem includes activities that clearly define product problem and collect information that relevantly described the existence of the problem.
This business activity may include tasks that measure or assess problem to determine whether a problem (i.e., discrepancy) exists.

name: Define Product Problem
brief_description: Define Product Problem business activity is in charge of describing a product problem.
extended_description:
Define Product Problem business activity is in charge of describing a product problem.

This business activity supports identifying product problem by leveraging collected product  information to clearly describe the product problem for subsequent resolution.

name: Collect Product Problem Information
brief_description: Collect Product Problem Information business activity is in charge of gathering all data/information that enable establish a product problem.
extended_description: Collect Product Problem Information business activity is in charge of gathering all data/information that enable establish a product problem.

name: Triage Product Problem
brief_description: Triage Product Problem business activity is in charge of organizing product problems based on business defined conditions to support analyzing and managing problem closure.
extended_description:
Triage Product Problem business activity is in charge of organizing product problems based on business defined conditions to support analyzing and managing problem closure.

Triage Product Problem includes tasks that categorize product problems in order to effectively prioritize handling according to their impact on business.

name: Categorize Product Problem
brief_description: Categorize Product Problem business activity is in charge of organizing and classifying product problems based on business conditions.
extended_description:
Categorize Product Problem business activity is in charge of organizing and classifying product problems based on business conditions.

Categorize Product Problem helps to cluster and correlate product problems in order to support triaging product problems with product problem solutions (if they exist solutions in the knowledge base.)

name: Prioritize Product Problem Management
brief_description: Prioritize Product Problem business activity is in charge of ordering product problems by level of urgency and impact based to the business.
extended_description:
Prioritize Product Problem business activity is in charge of ordering product problems by level of urgency and impact based to the business.

Prioritize Product Problem business activity supports Categorize Product Problem in order to effectively Triage Product Problem.

name: Analyze Product Problem
brief_description: Analyze Product Problem business activity is in charge of investigating product problems, discovering product problem cause and providing relevant reports to outline problem product cause.
extended_description:
Analyze Product Problem business activity is in charge of investigating product problems, discovering product problem cause and providing relevant reports to outline problem product cause.

This business activity is key to identify appropriate solutions to product problems, and inform the right plan of action to resolve product problems.

name: Investigate Product Problem
brief_description: Investigate Product Problem business activity is in charge of observing and identifying the cause of a product problem.
extended_description:
Investigate Product Problem business activity is in charge of observing and identifying the cause of a product problem.

Investigate Product Problem includes tasks that study and examine product problems and associated information in order to discover product problem cause.

name: Report Product Problem Cause
brief_description: Report Product Problem Cause business activity in charge of providing documented (written or verbal) evidence of the cause of a product problem.
extended_description:
Report Product Problem Cause business activity in charge of providing documented (written or verbal) evidence of the cause of a product problem.

This business activity supports Investigate Product Problem to present the analysis of a product problem.

name: Discover Product Problem Cause
brief_description: Discover Product Problem business activity is in charge of obtaining evidence of the investigation of the product problem.
extended_description: Discover Product Problem business activity is in charge of obtaining evidence of the investigation of the product problem.

name: Manage Product Problem Solution
brief_description: Manage Product Problem Solution business activity is in charge of directing and controlling activities that establish solutions to resolve product problems.
extended_description:
Manage Product Problem Solution business activity is in charge of directing and controlling activities that establish solutions to resolve product problems.

Manage Product Problem Solution includes activities that identify and define all product problem solutions, establish course of action for resolving product problems according to solutions, reviewing product problem solutions to be effective, implement established plans for resolving or correcting product problems and reporting on implementation of product problem solutions.

name: Define Product Problem Solution
brief_description: Define Product Problem Solution business activity is in charge of finding and describing solutions to the product problem.
extended_description:
Define Product Problem Solution business activity is in charge of finding and describing solutions and solution goals to the product problem.

This business activity acts to identify a set of solutions to a product problem each with well-described goals. Goals may be strategic or tactical.

name: Plan Product Problem Solution
brief_description: Plan Product Problem Solution business activity is in charge of identifying tasks and actions that enable implement answers or correction to a product problem.
extended_description:
Plan Product Problem Solution business activity is in charge of identifying tasks and actions that enable implement answers or correction to a product problem.

This business activity ensures that the set of actions and tasks to resolve or solve a product problem solution meet the solution goals.
a set of solutions to a product problem. evidence of the investigation of the product problem.

name: Implement Product Problem Solution
brief_description: Implement Product Problem Solution business activity is in charge of executing the set of tasks identified to address or correct product problem.
extended_description:
Implement Product Problem Solution business activity is in charge of executing the set of tasks identified to address or correct product problem.

Implement Product Problem Solution ensures that plans and their goals match business expectations.

name: Review Product Problem Solution
brief_description: Review Product Problem Solution business activity is in charge of inspecting and authorizing a product problem solution.
extended_description:
Review Product Problem Solution business activity is in charge of inspecting and authorizing a product problem solution.

This business activity ensures that from the set of problem solutions defined, the most appropriate that fits the goals of the business are implemented.

name: Validate Product Problem Solution
