extended_description: Manage activities associated with securities/shares of the enterprise and any securities/company regulations impacting on the company, including the administration and management of continuous disclosure/announcements to the securities exchange and/or securities/company regulator.

name: Manage Capital/Equity Activities
brief_description: Manage all activities associated with modifying the capital/equity structure of the enterprise, including all logistics functions associated with approaching the market for capital/increased equity.

name: Manage Share/Stock Registry
brief_description: Manage and administer the enterprise’s share/stock registry.

name: Manage Enterprise Transparency
brief_description: Manage Enterprise Transparency business activity is in charge of enabling open communication and assuring free flow of information and data within the enterprise, and with customers, business partners and all other stakeholders.
extended_description:
Manage Enterprise Transparency business activity is in charge of enabling open communication and assuring free flow of information and data within the enterprise, and with customers, business partners and all other stakeholders.

Manage Transparency business activity include tasks to Establish Trust and Manage Disclosure of information and data. This is in order to foster the belief in the accuracy, reliability and timely exchanges between the enterprise and customers, business partners, employees and other stakeholders.

name: Establish Trust
brief_description: Establish Trust business activity sets up an environment in the enterprise that foster positive relationships, good judgement with expertise, and maintaining consistency in exchanges across all interactions and experiences.
extended_description:
Establish Trust business activity sets up an environment in the enterprise that foster positive relationships, good judgement with expertise, and maintaining consistency in exchanges across all interactions and experiences.

Establish Trust business activity supports the enterprise to Manage Transparency by facilitating consistent and open exchanges with customers, business partners, employees and all other stakeholders.

name: Manage Disclosure
brief_description: Manage Disclosure business activity is in charge of directing and controlling the release and publication of facts or information known customers, business partners, employees and other stakeholders (such as investors).
extended_description:
Manage Disclosure business activity is in charge of directing and controlling the release and publication of facts or information known customers, business partners, employees and other stakeholders (such as investors).

Manage Disclosure business activity includes tasks that consolidate data and information,  maintains repository of documents and reports required for statutory reporting (e.g. regulatory filings). Manage Disclosure by enterprises makes customers, investors, and stakeholders involved in doing business with the company aware of pertinent information.

name: Manage Standards
brief_description: Manage Standards business activity is in charge of controlling and directing all activities that support creating protocols that guide the enterprise in creating, applying and using products and services based on the consensus of all the relevant parties in the industry.
extended_description:
Manage Standards business activity is in charge of controlling and directing all activities that support creating protocols that guide the enterprise in creating, applying and using products and services based on the consensus of all the relevant parties in the industry.

Manage Standards business activity ensures the safety, interoperability, and compatibility of products and services used by the enterprise and with partners (traditional or ecosystem partners).

name: Define Standardization Requirement
brief_description:
Define Standardization Requirement
Manage Standardization Requirement business activity states and describes the needs that must support the development of standards across the enterprise.
extended_description:
Define Standardization Requirement
Manage Standardization Requirement business activity states and describes the needs that must support the development of standards across the enterprise.

Manage Standardization Requirement supports the Manage Standards business activity by ensuring that there exists the steps and check points that assure there is consensus underpinning the establishment, documenting, analyzing, tracing, prioritizing and agreeing on requirements for standards.

name: Establish Best Practice Model
brief_description: Establish Best Practices Model business activity sets up the generally accepted ideas or methods that are considered superior and documents them along with the results they produce.
extended_description:
Establish Best Practices Model business activity sets up the generally accepted ideas or methods that are considered superior and documents them along with the results they produce.

Establish Best Practice Model business activities include tasks that describe the representational view or framework that embody the practice and proven solutions that help to address a problem or goals for the best practice. The value behind establishing these best practices model is to identify methods that are confirmed as effective, and reduce the need to 'reinvent the wheel'.

name: Legitimize Standard
brief_description: Legitimize Standard business activity is in charge of approve and allowing a standard to be formally accepted by the enterprise and its business functions.
extended_description: Legitimize Standard business activity is in charge of approve and allowing a standard to be formally accepted by the enterprise and its business functions.

name: Systematize Standards Use
brief_description: Systematize Standards Use business activity is  in charge of applying, evaluating and managing the lifecycle of standards formally recognized by the enterprise.
extended_description: Systematize Standards Use business activity is  in charge of applying, evaluating and managing the lifecycle of standards formally recognized by the enterprise.

name: Manage Integrity
brief_description: Manage Integrity business activity is in charge maintaining the highest ethical standards in every aspect of enterprises' business.
extended_description:
Manage Integrity business activity is in charge maintaining the highest ethical standards in every aspect of enterprises' business.

Manage Integrity tasks include assessing integrity, responding to integrity assessment, managing ethics, and managing the enterprises'' reputation. This business activity will leverage Risk Management in supporting the enterprise governance objectives.

Manage Integrity will provide ongoing and systematized processes to guide behaviors which assure integrity of people, processes and products in the enterprise, and with partners. Code Of Conduct (COC) is one of the fundamental artefacts managed by this business activity.

name: Remediate Integrity Assessment
brief_description: Remediate Integrity Assessment business activity is in charge of responding to findings from the enterprises integrity assessment.
extended_description: Remediate Integrity Assessment business activity is in charge of responding to findings from the enterprises integrity assessment.

name: Assess Integrity
brief_description: Assess Integrity business activity is in charge of defining assessment criteria, selecting assessment measures, designing assessment plans, collecting assessment results and interpreting integrity assessment results.
extended_description: Assess Integrity business activity is in charge of defining assessment criteria, selecting assessment measures, designing assessment plans, collecting assessment results and interpreting integrity assessment results.

name: Manage Ethics
brief_description: Manage Ethics business activity is in charge of creating, directing and controlling how actions of all internal enterprise stakeholder follow moral values or principles established by the enterprise.
extended_description:
Manage Ethics business activity is in charge of creating, directing and controlling how actions of all internal enterprise stakeholder follow moral values or principles established by the enterprise.

This business activity is in charge of directing, as well as control enterprise tasks and outcomes that focus on meeting well-defined moral values or principles created. Manage Ethics is a key business activity to support Manage Integrity.

name: Manage Reputation
brief_description: Manage Reputation business activity is in charge of directing and controlling the influence and perception of the enterprise brand.
extended_description:
Manage Reputation business activity is in charge of directing and controlling the influence and perception of the enterprise brand.

Manage Reputation business activity includes activities that responding to customer, business partner, employee and all other stakeholder feedback, monitoring enterprise reputation, addressing any content or feedback (from employees, customers, business partners and external parties) that can damage the brand.  Manage Reputation is a key business activity to support Manage Integrity.

name: Learning Management
brief_description: Learning Management business process manage activities that support building skills that can be applied to a variety of context.
extended_description: Learning Management business process manage activities that support building skills that can be applied to a variety of context. Learning Management business process have outcome that results in absorbing information in order to increase skills and abilities and make use of it under a variety of contexts. In contrast to training management, which focuses on the (organization) way to impact information and knowledge to instruct a trainee, learning management is about the persona involved.

name: Assess Learning Needs
brief_description: Assess Learning Needs business activity analyze and evaluate participants learning needs to identify what participants have learned, how well they learned it and where they struggled.
extended_description: Assess Learning Needs business activity analyze and evaluate participants learning needs to identify what participants have learned, how well and where there was struggle.   Assess Learning Needs is a key activity in the learning lifecycle management. Learning Need is the gap between the learner's current level of knowledge and skills, and the level of knowledge and skills required to perform a task or a set of tasks. Assess Learning Needs helps to determine target, examine learning goals, and determine learning resources.

name: Define Learning Objectives
brief_description: Define Learning Objectives business activity establishes the overall purpose or goal from participating in a learning activity.
extended_description: Define Learning Objectives business activity establishes the overall purpose or goal from participating in a learning activity.  Define Learning Objectives establish outcomes that capture specifically what knowledge, skills, attitudes a learning program should be able to exhibit following instruction. Define Learning Objectives include defining desired outcomes (performance, conditions, and criteria), and 'define learning resources'.

name: Define Desired Outcomes
brief_description: Define Desired Outcomes business activity support 'Define Learning Objectives; by establishing the specific performance statement to describe the results after a learning cycle.
extended_description: Define Desired Outcomes business activity support 'Define Learning Objectives; by establishing the specific performance statement to describe the results after a learning cycle.  Define Desired Outcomes business activity establish performance conditions and criteria that describe what the learner will know or be able to do in specific, measurable terms.  Example of a Learning Objective is "Be able to felicitate customer requirements correctly."

name: Build Learning Resources
brief_description: Build Learning Resources business activity establishes the learning materials or resources that instructors may use to carry out instruction and facilitate the achievement of learning goals.
extended_description: Build Learning Resources business activity establishes the learning materials or resources that instructors may use to carry out instruction and facilitate the achievement of learning goals.  Build Learning Resources ensures clear learning topics, learning resource content, develops learning concepts, and defines learning plans required to meet learning modes.

name: Identify Learning Topics
brief_description: Identify Learning Topics business activity discover relevant to support a learning objective based on the learners needs assessment outcome.
extended_description: Identify Learning Topics business activity discover relevant to support a learning objective based on the learners needs assessment outcome.

name: Acquire Learning Resource Content
brief_description: Acquire Learning Resource Content business activity obtain content relevant to establish curriculum for a Learning Topic.
extended_description: Acquire Learning Resource Content business activity obtain content relevant to establish curriculum for a Learning Topic.

name: Develop Learning Concepts
brief_description: Develop Learning Concepts business activity establish and evolve ideas that promote successful learning resource delivery.
extended_description: Develop Learning Concepts business activity establish and evolve ideas that promote successful learning resource delivery.  This business activity support Training Management by providing methods for training in order to get learners to think about the 'how' and 'why' of learning.

name: Develop Learning Program
brief_description: Develop Learning Program business activity establish the overall initiative and scheme to deliver a learning experience required to achieve competence.
extended_description: Develop Learning Program business activity establish the overall initiative and scheme to deliver a learning experience required to achieve competence.  Develop Learning Program models and develops the overall learning program to provide trainers/assessors with details about the objectives of learning and assessment; the vocational knowledge, skills or competency that learners are supported to achieve according to an overall program; a profile of the learners and their needs; and suggestions for assessment methods.

name: Model Learning Program
brief_description: Model Learning Program business activity establish a cohesive and integrated learning process for learners with input from defined learning outcome.  Model Learning Program use learning outcomes or the learning objectives (derived from the competency stan
extended_description: Model Learning Program business activity establish a cohesive and integrated learning process for learners with input from defined learning outcome.  Model Learning Program use learning outcomes or the learning objectives (derived from the competency standards or other criteria) and outline the content, sequence and structure of learning and the delivery and assessment method/s to be used.

name: Develop Learning Plan
brief_description: Develop Learning Plan establishes a the activity schedule that defines how to achieve desired outcomes for a learning objective.
extended_description: Develop Learning Plan establishes a the activity schedule that defines how to achieve desired outcomes for a learning objective.  Develop Learning Plan ensures clarity so that the progress is orderly and efficient.  It includes steps to leverage learning goals as input to identify how individual learning plans may achieve one or several learning goals/objectives. It includes conducting learner assessment, applying learning styles, and when to initiate learning activities to support the goals.

name: Implement Learning Program
brief_description: Implement Learning Program business activity instantiates all the related learning plans and coordinates them under an integrated initiative to support achieving the learning program's experience objective.
extended_description: Implement Learning Program business activity instantiates all the related learning plans and coordinates them under an integrated initiative to support achieving the learning program's experience objective.  Implement Learning Program implements the individual units of competency and provides the detailed plans for learners to achieve the specified learning outcomes.  'Learning Program' provide 'Training Management' with input for 'Evaluate Training Program'.

name: Evaluate Learning Program
brief_description: Evaluate Learning Program business activity assess performance of the Learning Program against overall learning objectives.
extended_description: Evaluate Learning Program business activity assess performance of the Learning Program against overall learning objectives.  Evaluating Learning Program is an ongoing activity that starts with assessing learning program performance needs (collecting learner feedback through performance assessments, and continues to support building learning resources (e.g. designing curricula and learning experiences, facilitating Learning etc.).

name: Collect Learner Feedback
brief_description: Collect Learner Feedback business activity supports 'Evaluate Learning Program' by managing activities that result in receiving information from learners about the learning program.
extended_description: Collect Learner Feedback business activity supports 'Evaluate Learning Program' by managing activities that result in receiving information from learners about the learning program.

name: Assess Learning Performance
brief_description: Assess Learning Performance business activity analyzes the  learning activities that support a learning program to evaluate levels of understanding of curriculum and content used in learning programs.  Assess Learning Performance helps to acquire learning
extended_description: Assess Learning Performance business activity analyzes the  learning activities that support a learning program to evaluate levels of understanding of curriculum and content used in learning programs.  Assess Learning Performance helps to acquire learning performance information from both the learning program, and individual learning plans using any or both of direct and indirect approach.

name: Training Management
brief_description: Training Management business process manage activities that instruct and deliver matters of technical knowledge according to learning management goals.
extended_description: Training Management business process manage activities that instruct and deliver matters of technical knowledge according to learning management goals.  Training Management ensures the most effective approach and capability is available to transmit knowledge or information. Training Management is core to the organization being able to match capability and capacity to provide impactful means to the organizations knowledge management goals. The practice of Training Management includes directing and organizing all the training activities for the organization, including assessing training needs, designing the training, implementing the training (such as scheduling and timing the instruction activities, handling training logistics) and evaluating training outcomes against needs.

name: Assess Training Needs
brief_description: Assess Training Needs business activity evaluates training gaps and needs, sets training objectives, evaluates roles, prepares plans and identifies place, people, process and technology capacity required to conduct and achieve a specified training objectives
extended_description:
Assess Training Needs business activity evaluates training gaps and needs, sets training objectives, evaluates roles, prepares plans and identifies place, people, process and technology capacity required to conduct and achieve a specified training objective.
Assess Training Needs lays the necessary groundwork for determining the enterprises needs and how participants in the training will best receive the required training.
Assess Training Needs captures skills proficiency of participants, frequency of skill usage and level of participants skill value to performance.
Output of an Assess Training Need business activity include a map of participant (who) and type of training approach that will be most impactful (how, what, when).

name: Design Training Program
brief_description: Design Training Program business activity develops the blueprint of capabilities and facilities that achieve training performance goals based on the enterprises learning objectives and knowledge management goals.
extended_description: Design Training Program business activity develops the blueprint of capabilities and facilities that achieve training performance goals based on the enterprises learning objectives and knowledge management goals.  Design Training Program correlates Learning Management objectives and prior Training Management lessons into training strategies most appropriate for participants. It includes designing the Training Objectives, Developing Training Plan and identifying the type/way/method to implement training (supervised: hands-on; unsupervised: simulation, experiential etc.) that is appropriate and impactful to participants.   The output of Design Training activity eradicates the gaps in training and with capability and facilities that assure better training performance.

name: Define Training Objectives
brief_description: Define Training Objectives business activity establishes the training program's capabilities and facility have set objectives that enable develop successful training program.
extended_description: Define Training Objectives business activity establishes the training program's capabilities and facility have set objectives that enable develop successful training program.

name: Develop Training Implementation Method
brief_description: Develop Training Implementation Method business activity generate the details that support executing the training plan's chosen method.
extended_description: Develop Training Implementation Method business activity generate the details that support executing the training plan's chosen method.

name: Develop Training Evaluation Model
brief_description: Develop Training Evaluation Model business activity generate the appraisal and rating structure to support the training plan.
extended_description: Develop Training Evaluation Model business activity generate the appraisal and rating structure to support the training plan.

name: Design Training Facility
brief_description: Design Training Facility business activity defines the specification required to support a training Plan.
extended_description: Design Training Facility business activity defines the specification required to support a training Plan.

name: Develop Training Plan
brief_description: Develop Training Plan business activity generate the detailed schedule and sequence of training activities that support achieving the training program.
extended_description: Develop Training Plan business activity generate the detailed schedule and sequence of training activities that support achieving the training program.

name: Acquire Training Capability
brief_description: Acquire Training Capability business activity establishes and makes ready the capability required to support a training plan.
extended_description: Acquire Training Capability business activity establishes and makes ready the capability required to support a training plan.

name: Schedule Training Program
brief_description: Acquire Training Capability business activity establishes and makes ready the capability required to support a training plan.
extended_description: Acquire Training Capability business activity establishes and makes ready the capability required to support a training plan.

name: Implement Training Program
brief_description: Implement Training Program business activity executes training plans altogether to achieve the goals of a training program.
extended_description: Implement Training Program business activity executes training plans altogether to achieve the goals of a training program.

name: Select Training Method
brief_description: Select Training Method business activity makes a choice of the method of training to be used in a training program.
extended_description: Select Training Method business activity makes a choice of the method of training to be used in a training program. Select Training Method  is responsible for guiding selection of the most appropriate training method(s). It takes input from the training assessment activity based on requirements identified between needs and gaps, and recommendations made during the Needs Analysis or training design activities.

name: Administer Training Program
brief_description: Administer Training Program business activity manages the responsibility for the implementation of the training program.
extended_description: Administer Training Program business activity manages the responsibility for the implementation of the training program. Administer Training Program is responsible for the coordination of trainers with training capability and facility. It administers the recordkeeping that tracks training capability, training facility, training participation progress, as well as administrating and budgeting tasks associated with training programs.

name: Evaluate Training Outcome
brief_description: Evaluate Training Outcome business activity assesses results of training program on participants.
extended_description: Evaluate Training Outcome business activity assesses results of training program on participants.  Evaluate Training Outcome provides feedback to help identify if training capability and facility achieved intended outcomes. It also helps to make decisions about future training capabilities and facilities.

name: Monitor Training
brief_description: Monitor Training business activity observes and tracks the enterprises training plans and programs.
extended_description:
Monitor Training business activity observes and tracks the enterprises training plans and programs.
 Monitor Training business activity allows the enterprise to maintain control of the training processes, while ensuring proactive adaptive response to the business.

name: Evaluate Training Program
brief_description: Evaluate Training Program business activity assess the enterprises training program support its business goals.
extended_description: Evaluate Training Program business activity assess the enterprises training program support its business goals.  Evaluate Training Program is the systematic process of collecting information and using that information to improve the enterprises training. Evaluate Training provides feedback to help identify if training programs achieve desired outcomes, and help make decisions about future training programs.

name: Research Management
brief_description: Research Management business process administers and controls the activities that support the collection, planning, organization, analysis and delivery of information that increase understanding of topics of concern to the enterprises' business functions.
extended_description: Research Management business process administers and controls the activities that support the collection, planning, organization, analysis and delivery of information that increase understanding of topics of concern to the enterprises' business functions. Research Management business processes promote creative and systematic activities that can be undertaken to increase the stock of knowledge. This business process supports 'knowledge management' business process.

name: Develop Research Approach
brief_description: Develop Research Approach business activity describe research methodology, describe data collection method, describe research analysis method, and evaluate and justify research methodology.
extended_description: Develop Research Approach business activity describe research methodology, describe data collection method, describe research analysis method, and evaluate and justify research methodology.  Develop Research Approach develop the research methodology from broad assumptions to detailed methods of data collection, analysis, and interpretation.

name: Describe Research Methodology
brief_description: Describe Research Methodology business activity define the procedures and techniques that are used to identify, select, process, and analyze information about a research topic.
extended_description: Describe Research Methodology business activity define the procedures and techniques that are used to identify, select, process, and analyze information about a research topic. Describe Research Methodology business activity define how a researcher systematically designs a study to ensure valid and reliable results that address the research aims and objectives.  Research Methodology describe research strategies, processes flows or techniques that will be utilized in the collection of data or evidence for analysis.

name: Describe Research Data Collection Method
brief_description: Describe Research Data Collection Method business activity define the research data collect information, and the research data collection sources to provide research insights and answers.
extended_description: Describe Research Data Collection Method business activity define the research data collect information, and the research data collection sources to provide research insights and answers. Describe Research Data Collection Method takes an input from 'describe research methodology' to identify the appropriate means sources of data collection, methods of data collection include documents review, observation, questioning, measuring, or a combination of different methods required.

name: Describe Research Analysis Method
brief_description: Describe Research Analysis Method business activity defines the approach that matches the objectives of the research.
extended_description: Describe Research Analysis Method business activity defines the approach that matches the objectives of the research.  Described Research Analysis Methods cover the tools and procedures used to collect and analyze data (for example, experiments, surveys, and statistical tests).

name: Evaluate and Justify Research Methodology
brief_description: Evaluate and Justify Research Methodology business activity assess research method and account for the methodological approach.
extended_description: Evaluate and Justify Research Methodology business activity assess research method and account for the methodological approach.  Evaluate and Justify Research Methodology begin by introducing overall approach to the research, evaluating the methods of data collection and/or selection, providing analysis on the methods and choices.

name: Plan Research
brief_description: Plan Research business activity establish the steps needed to be performed in a logical and concise manner.
extended_description: Plan Research business activity establish the steps needed to be performed in a logical and concise manner. Plan Research business activity includes tasks that recognize and develop the research topic, perform preliminary research for data, the allocation of capability, appraising data sources and activities to finalize the research.

name: Define Research Topic
brief_description: Define Research Topic business activity describes the subject or issue that a researcher must focus on when conducting research.
extended_description: Define Research Topic business activity describes the subject or issue that a researcher must focus on when conducting research.  Define Research Topic provides a well-defined research topic as starting point of every successful research project. The choice of a topic is an ongoing process by which researchers explore, define, and refine ideas.

name: Identify Research objectives
brief_description: Identify Research Objectives business activity pinpoint and research goals and targets and discern the focus of research.
extended_description: Identify Research Objectives business activity pinpoint and research goals and targets and discern the focus of research.  This business activity includes breaking down the research focus into research targets and defining criteria to evaluate research objectives.

name: Select Research Method
brief_description: Select Research Method business activity match the best research method to research objectives.
extended_description: Select Research Method business activity match the best research method to research objectives.  Select Research Method activity may take input from 'Identify Research Topic' and 'Identify Research Objectives' to understand the best research analysis option (qualitative research, quantitative research a mix of both) to support the research methodology.

name: Build Research Capacity
brief_description: Build Research Capacity business activity develops the abilities and skills enabling the enterprise to perform research.
extended_description: Build Research Capacity business activity develops the abilities and skills enabling the enterprise to perform research. Build Research Capacity addresses individual and enterprise-wide research capacity development which leads to higher levels of skills and greater ability to perform research.

name: Develop Research Brief
brief_description: Develop Research Brief business activity builds out the research briefings to provide a concise summary of research knowledge on a particular topic.
extended_description: Develop Research Brief business activity builds out the research briefings to provide a concise summary of research knowledge on a particular topic.  Develop Research Brief business activity will summarize research evidence in an accessible form to the research audience.

name: Establish Research timeline
brief_description: Establish Research timeline business activity define clear schedules, start and end dates/times for a research plan.
extended_description: Establish Research timeline business activity define clear schedules, start and end dates/times for a research plan.

name: Define Research Report Requirement
brief_description: Define Research Report Requirement business activity describe the written or formal outcome of findings and observation of the research.
extended_description: Define Research Report Requirement business activity describe the written or formal outcome of findings and observation of the research.

name: Analyze Research Findings
brief_description: Analyze Research Findings business activity examine the research findings.
extended_description: Analyze Research Findings business activity examine the research findings.  This business activity breaks research findings down into parts in order to evaluate the insights from the research.

name: Identify Relevant Research Information
brief_description: Identify Relevant Research Information business activity find and discern the right research information to support analyzing for research findings.
extended_description: Identify Relevant Research Information business activity find and discern the right research information to support analyzing for research findings.

name: Identify Research Reports & References
brief_description: Identify Research Reports & References business activity capture reports and references that support analyzing research findings.
extended_description: Identify Research Reports & References business activity capture reports and references that support analyzing research findings.

name: Clarify Unclear Research Points
brief_description: Clarify Unclear Research Points business activity provide comprehensible information around research points that are need explanation to resolve answers to points around research topics.
extended_description: Clarify Unclear Research Points business activity provide comprehensible information around research points that are need explanation to resolve answers to points around research topics.

name: Explain Research Findings
brief_description: Explain Research Findings business activity describe in detail findings from research topics.
extended_description: Explain Research Findings business activity describe in detail findings from research topics.

name: Deliver Research Results
brief_description: Deliver Research Results business activity address modelling research reports for research report recipients with clear insights, ad actionable recommendations for a research.
extended_description: Deliver Research Results business activity address modeling research reports for research report recipients with clear insights, ad actionable recommendations for a research.

name: Corporate Finance Management
brief_description: Corporate Finance Management business process directs and controls corporate activities that source and allocate funding, organizing capital structure, overseeing activities to increase the value of the firm, and managing the tools used to allocate financial resources.
extended_description:
Corporate Finance Management business process directs and controls corporate activities that source and allocate funding, organizing capital structure, overseeing activities to increase the value of the firm, and managing the tools used to allocate financial resources.

Corporate Finance Management ensures capital budgets, capital structure, and working capital are managed individually and collectively to maximize the value of the company through its financing and investment decisions, i.e. how to best raise money and use it.

Corporate finance functions are charged with governing and overseeing the enterprises financial activities and capital investment decisions.

name: Manage Capital Investment
brief_description: Manage Capital Investment business activity directs and controls corporate expenditure of money to fund the enterprises long-term growth.
extended_description:
Manage Capital Investment business activity directs and controls corporate expenditure of money to fund the enterprises long-term growth.

Manage Capital Investment can facilitate enterprises acquisition of permanent fixed assets such as real estate and equipment, or provide diversification leveraging Manage Capital Investment business activity. This includes diversification strategies like replacements and modernization.

name: Manage Capital Financing
brief_description: Manage Capital Financing business activity directs and controls the methods the corporate business uses to raise money.
extended_description:
Manage Capital Financing business activity directs and controls the methods the corporate business uses to raise money.

Manage Capital Financing covers tasks that manage debt financing (i.e. borrowing money to pay for business operations) an equity financing (i.e. selling ownership stake in the enterprise).

name: Manage Capital Structure
brief_description: Manage Capital Structure business activity directs and controls how the enterprise is financing its operations.
extended_description: Manage Capital Structure business activity directs and controls how the enterprise is financing its operations.

name: Manage Capital Budgeting
brief_description: Manage Capital Budgeting business activity directs and controls the evaluation of prospective investment.
extended_description:
Manage Capital Budgeting business activity directs and controls the evaluation of prospective investment.

Manage Capital Budgeting helps to map out the cash outlays and cash inflows associated with an investment.

name: Manage Liquidity
brief_description: Manage Liquidity business activity directs and controls corporate visibility into the enterprise cash position.
extended_description:
Manage Liquidity business activity directs and controls corporate visibility into the enterprise cash position.

Manage Liquidity can be long-term, but for short-term it enables the enterprise to improve decision-making. Visibility into a firm's cash and liquidity position allows corporate treasurers to analyze surplus funds to make better investment and borrowing decisions.

This business activity handles tasks make decisions around working capital and operating cashflows (current assets and current liabilities) in order to avoid disrupting the enterprises business operations. These activities can extend to getting additional credit lines or activating liquidity backups.

name: Manage Managerial Accounting

Define the dominant regulation
Define the highest standards that apply for multiple legislative locations.
etc.

name: Enterprise Information Management
brief_description:
Enterprise Information Management business activity controls and oversee the management of information, information and data models, information/data integration, and access to information and data from its creation to retirement, so as to optimize its utility, minimize legal risks, and inform business decisions.
Manage Information business activity is in charge of defining the enterprise plan and approach to direct and control Information and data following a lifecycle from creation to final disposal.
extended_description:
Enterprise Information Management business activity controls and oversee the management of information, information and data models, information/data integration, and access to information and data from its creation to retirement, so as to optimize its utility, minimize legal risks, and inform business decisions. Manage Information aligns information with business requirements through service levels and management policies for all data types, including master data, reference data, transactional data, metadata, unstructured data, integrated data, and application data exchange. The process involves activities for data acquisition, creation, modeling, storage, maintenance, processing, distribution, disposition, and archival. Manage Information & Data Lifecycle business activity is in charge of defining the enterprise plan and approach to direct and control Information and data following a lifecycle from creation to final disposal.
This process was renamed in 23.5. Old name was Manage Information & Data
in 24.0 this process was changed it was an L4 process and was called Manage Information & Data

name: Manage Master Data
brief_description: Manage Master Data business activity directs and controls tasks to create a master record for each entity (person, place, or thing) in a business, from across internal and external data sources and applications.
extended_description:
Manage Master Data business activity directs and controls tasks to create a master record for each entity (person, place, or thing) in a business, from across internal and external data sources and applications.

Manage Master Data ensures that the enterprise delivers consistent and trusted data to every user, promotes accurate reporting, reduces data errors, removes redundancy, and helps the organization make better-informed business decisions. It creates a master record (also known as a “golden record” or “best version of the truth”) that contains the essential information on which the business/organization relies.

name: Manage Master Data Integration
brief_description: Manage Master Data Integration business activity direct and control tasks to syndicate master data for a harmonized view across all business applications.
extended_description: Manage Master Data Integration business activity direct and control tasks to syndicate master data for a harmonized view across all business applications. Manage Master Data Integration ensure that master data is consistently integrated across various systems in an organization with the aim of achieving a coherent enterprise data model with common semantics that can be used to exchange data between business applications. This business activity involves data mapping, transformation, and loading (ETL), data synchronization, conflict resolution, and distributing master data based on a common model for end-to-end process integration.

name: Manage Master Data Quality
brief_description: Manage Master Data Quality business activity direct and control tasks to ensure and improve the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of master data.
extended_description:
Manage Master Data Quality business activity direct and control tasks to ensure and improve the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of master data.

Manage Master Data Quality ensure the reliability of business decisions made based on the information/data, comply with regulations, and increase operational efficiency. It involves activities such as data profiling, data cleansing, data enrichment, and ongoing data quality monitoring.

name: Manage Master Data Lifecycle
brief_description: Manage Master Data Lifecycle business activity direct and control tasks to manage the entire lifecycle of master data from creation to retirement.
extended_description:
Manage Master Data Lifecycle business activity direct and control tasks to manage the entire lifecycle of master data from creation to retirement.

Manage Master Data Lifecycle ensure data relevancy, compliance with data retention policies, and optimize storage resources. It involves activities such as master data creation, master data usage and update, master data archiving, and master data removal/deletion.

name: Create Master Data
brief_description: Create Master Data business activity is responsible for initiating a new set of master data, and ensuring that new master data is accurate, consistent, and relevant to the business.
extended_description:
Create Master Data business activity is responsible for initiating a new set of master data, and ensuring that new master data is accurate, consistent, and relevant to the business.

Create Master Data involves identifying master data, evaluating data sources, analyzing metadata, and analyzing underlying master data lifecycle(s) according to business goals.

name: Update Master Data
brief_description: Update Master Data business activity is responsible for making changes to existing master data to ensure it remains accurate and up-to-date.
extended_description:
Update Master Data business activity is responsible for making changes to existing master data to ensure it remains accurate and up-to-date.

Update Master Data maintains the integrity of the master data, ensuring it reflects current business realities, and improves business activities and events.

name: Collect Master Data
brief_description: Collect Master Data business activity is responsible for gathering master data from various sources.
extended_description:
Collect Master Data business activity is responsible for gathering master data from various sources.

Collect Master Data ensures data's accuracy, completeness, and relevance to the organization based on a well-defined scope. It involves defining the role of the master data, choosing the data collection method, planning data collection procedures, and collecting the data.

name: Remove Master Data
brief_description: Remove Master Data business activity is responsible for deleting or deactivating master data that is no longer needed in order to maintain the relevancy of master data, comply with data retention policies, and optimize storage resources.
extended_description:
Remove Master Data business activity is responsible for deleting or deactivating master data that is no longer needed in order to maintain the relevancy of master data, comply with data retention policies, and optimize storage resources.

Remove Master Data business activity involves cleaning up to remove or deactivate master data records and disassociating mastership of such data.

name: Manage Transactional Data
brief_description: Manage Transactional Data business activity directs and controls activities to track and manage business and operations transaction data.
extended_description:
Manage Transactional Data business activity directs and controls activities to track and manage business and operations transaction data.

Manage Transactional Data ensures that enterprises can understand behavior, understand the context of activity-generated data, track business events or actions and gain insights into business operations.

name: Manage Transactional Data Integration
brief_description: Manage Transactional Data Integration business activity directs and controls tasks to ensure transactional data is consistently integrated across various systems in an organization.
extended_description:
Manage Transactional Data Integration business activity directs and controls tasks to ensure transactional data is consistently integrated across various systems in an organization.

Manage Transactional Data Integration improves data consistency, reduce redundancy, and ensure that all systems are using the same, most up-to-date version of data.
It includes activities that do data mapping, data transformation, data loading (ETL), data synchronization, and data conflict resolution.

name: Manage Transactional Data Quality

extended_description:

Manage Transactional Data Quality improve the reliability of business decisions made based on the data, comply with regulations, and increase operational efficiency. It includes activities that perform transactional data profiling, transactional data cleansing, transactional data enrichment, and ongoing transactional data quality monitoring.

name: Manage Transactional Data Lifecycle

extended_description: Manage Transactional Data Lifecycle ensure transactional data relevancy, comply with data retention policies, and optimize storage resources. Underlying tasks include transactional data creation, transactional data collection and usage, transactional data update, transactional data archiving, and deletion.

name: Create Transactional Data

name: Update Transactional Data

name: Manage Reference Data

extended_description:
Manage Reference Data business activity directs and controls tasks to define lookup data (e.g. location data, currency, transaction codes etc) or controlled vocabulary (country names, city names etc.) used to classify and characterize other information and data so as to ensure consistent and continued viability of information / data used for operations and decision making.

Manage Reference Data involves managing reference data with technology, such as automating workflows to create new codes and code sets, delivering codes and code sets to data users, and mapping data. Manage Reference Data is required to properly manage reference data e.g. location (Country, City, Town, Street, Street numbers), currency, language codes etc. This process includes tasks to handle information/data collection from public or private sources, potential on-site visits for further controls, history management, etc.)

name: Manage Reference Data Integration

extended_description:
Manage Reference Data Integration business activity directs and controls the seamless integration of reference data (such as location, currency, transaction codes, units, etc) across various systems and platforms within an organization.

Manage Reference Data Integration ensures that reference data is consistently and accurately represented across all systems, thereby reducing discrepancies and improving data integrity. Manage Reference Data Integration facilitates efficient data sharing and synchronization across different business units and includes activities that map reference data, consolidate reference data, and establish reference data integration protocols.

name: Manage Reference Data Quality

name: Create Reference Data

name: Collect Reference Data

name: Remove Reference Data

name: Manage Location Information
brief_description: Manage Location Information business activity is responsible for coordinating activities that direct and control physical and/or virtual location information of interest to the organization.
extended_description:
Manage Location Information business activity is responsible for coordinating activities that direct and control physical and/or virtual location information of interest to the organization. Manage Location Information includes coordinating the tasks that define location requirement, establish location information, allocate location information, promote location, evaluate locations and maintain locations according to the organization's strategic objectives, and operational requirements. These activities ensure efficient utilization of space, resources, and infrastructure, such as managing office spaces, warehouses, retail stores, site, data centers or distribution centers.
Manage Location is a decision-supporting activity that identifies, evaluates, selects and determines the optimal position or place where a use (marketing, sales, customers, products, services and resources) is identified, referenced or situated. This decision-supporting activity will manage location data to enable maximize business value (market share, reduce product/service/resource costs, and enhance customer accessibility).

name: Define Location Requirement
brief_description: “Define Location Requirement task is responsible for identifying and documenting the specific criteria (like specifying the location criteria) that a location must meet to support the organization's operational needs.”
extended_description:
“Define Location Requirement task is responsible for identifying and documenting the specific criteria (like specifying the location criteria) that a location must meet to support the organization's operational needs.”
 Define Location Requirement task supports management of location by setting the considerations and needs, such as location size, location accessibility, relevant location infrastructure, and any proximity to key resources or markets to met a location need.

name: Select Location
brief_description: Select Location task is responsible for choosing the most suitable location based on predefined criteria. Select Location includes tasks that shortlist location, obtain location information, search location and match location.
extended_description: Select Location task is responsible for choosing the most suitable location based on predefined criteria. Select Location includes tasks that shortlist location, obtain location information, search location and match location. Select Location supports the location decision-making of the organization when evaluating potential locations against the defined criteria to choose the most suitable location for its operations. This task involves filtering through various locations based on set factors (like budget, location features, and strategic fit) to create a manageable list of location candidates for final consideration.

name: Shortlist Location
brief_description: Shortlist Location task is responsible for narrowing down potential locations to a manageable number for in-depth evaluation, based on preliminary assessments against the organization's location requirements.
extended_description:
Shortlist Location task is responsible for narrowing down potential locations to a manageable number for in-depth evaluation, based on preliminary assessments against the organization's location requirements.
Shortlist Location support location selection by providing the best potential locations from a larger list of locations that are viable to meet the locations purpose.

name: Obtain Location Information
brief_description: Shortlist Location task is responsible for narrowing down potential locations to a manageable number for in-depth evaluation, based on preliminary assessments against the organization's location requirements.
extended_description: Obtain Location Information task is responsible for gathering the detailed data about potential locations through relevant methods (such as reconnaissance, site visits, and research) to inform the selection process.

name: Match Location
brief_description: Match Location task is responsible for comparing shortlist locations with the organization's specific location requirements to identify the best fit for operational needs.
extended_description: Match Location task is responsible for comparing shortlist locations with the organization's specific location requirements to identify the best fit for operational needs.

name: Search Location
brief_description: Search Location task is responsible for actively exploring and investigating potential sites that could meet the organization's location criteria.
extended_description:
Search Location task is responsible for actively exploring and investigating potential sites that could meet the organization's location criteria.
Search Location includes tasks to set the location's search criteria, and retrieve all matches that meet the search criteria.

name: Set Location Search Criteria
brief_description: Set Location Search Criteria task is responsible for establishing the parameters and conditions that potential locations must satisfy during the search process.
extended_description:
Set Location Search Criteria task is responsible for establishing the parameters and conditions that potential locations must satisfy during the search process.
Set Location Search Criteria task includes actions to identify key factors such as geographic preferences, size requirements, location budget constraints, and specific facility needs that will shape the location search process.

name: Retrieve Location Match
brief_description: Retrieve Location Match task is responsible for identifying and compiling a list of locations that align with the search criteria set by the organization.
extended_description:
Retrieve Location Match task is responsible for identifying and compiling a list of locations that align with the search criteria set by the organization.
Retrieve Location Match task includes actions to compile and analyze data on potential locations to present a selection that aligns with the organization's defined needs and preferences.

name: Establish Location
brief_description: Establish Location task is responsible for formalizing the setting up of a location, including legal, logistical, and operational arrangements, to make it functional for the organization's use.
extended_description: Establish Location task is responsible for formalizing the setting up of a location, including legal, logistical, and operational arrangements, to make it functional for the organization's use. Establish Location task includes tasks to demarcate location, define location address scheme, establish location address reference, and integrate location. The task ensures the organization can finalize all administrative activities to confirm the existence of a location, such as registry data, lease agreements or purchases, plans for use, and coordinating the logistics of setting up the new location for use.

name: Demarcate Location
brief_description: Demarcate Location task is responsible for defining the boundaries (physical and/or virtual) and size of a location to delineate the operational space.
extended_description:
Demarcate Location task is responsible for defining the boundaries (physical and/or virtual) and size of a location to delineate the operational space.
Demarcate Location task includes actions to map and mark out locations based through zoning/segmentation/spacing etc., ensuring the location meets a spatial requirement. Further more it supports documenting the demarcated details for legal and operational purposes.

name: Define Location Address Scheme
brief_description: Define Location Address Scheme task is responsible for creating a systematic approach to assigning addresses within a location to facilitate identification and navigation.
extended_description:
Define Location Address Scheme task is responsible for creating a systematic approach to assigning addresses within a location to facilitate identification and navigation.
Define Location Address Scheme task includes actions hat develop a logical and systematic addressing system that can be easily understood and used by the organization, customers, suppliers and partners.

name: Establish Location Address Reference
brief_description: Establish Location Address Reference tasks is responsible for setting up a system for referencing and cataloging location addresses within the organization.
extended_description:
Establish Location Address Reference tasks is responsible for setting up a system for referencing and cataloging location addresses within the organization.
Establish Location Address Reference task includes actions to create database or directory that contain all address-related information for a location, ensuring it is accessible and up-to-date for internal and external use.

name: Integrate Location Address
brief_description: Integrate Location Address task is responsible for incorporating the address scheme into the organization’s broader operational framework.
extended_description:
Integrate Location Address task is responsible for incorporating the address scheme into the organization’s broader operational framework.
Integrate Location Address task includes actions to ensure that the address of locations are consistently used across all business functions and underlying platforms, from mail services to digital maps, applications, location registries and directories.

name: Allocate Location
brief_description: Allocate Location task is responsible for assigning specific spaces/zones/demarcated areas within a location to different functions or individuals based on the organization’s needs.
extended_description:
Allocate Location task is responsible for assigning specific spaces/zones/demarcated areas within a location to different functions or individuals based on the organization’s needs.
Allocate Location task includes preparing location through plans, and assigning locations by distributing location areas/zones/spaces to maximize efficiency and meet the organization's operational requirements.

name: Prepare Location
brief_description: Prepare Location task is responsible for making necessary adjustments and arrangements to ensure the space/zone/demarcated area corresponding to the location is ready for use.
extended_description:
Prepare Location task is responsible for making necessary adjustments and arrangements to ensure the space/zone/demarcated area corresponding to the location is ready for use.
Prepare Location task includes tasks such as outfitting the location (with amenities, furniture, equipment, utility access and technology etc.), as well as ensuring compliance with safety and accessibility standards.

name: Assign Location
brief_description: Assign Location task involves designating specific areas or spaces within a location to particular functions, teams, or individuals.
extended_description:
Assign Location task involves designating specific areas or spaces within a location to particular functions, teams, or individuals.
 Assign Location task includes actions to determine the best use of location based on the organization and its work flows, and clearly communicating these assignments to all relevant parties.

name: Promote Location
brief_description: Promote Location task is responsible for enhancing the visibility and appeal of a location to attract use.
extended_description:
Promote Location task is responsible for enhancing the visibility and appeal of a location to attract use.
Promote Location task includes actions to support marketing activities of the location (e.g. Site sharing preparation, and engaging in value driven outreach) so as to highlight the benefits and features of the location.

name: Evaluate Location
brief_description: Evaluate Location task is responsible for assessing the suitability and performance of a location against the organization’s objectives and performance criteria.
extended_description:
Evaluate Location task is responsible for assessing the suitability and performance of a location against the organization’s objectives and performance criteria.
 Evaluate Location task includes actions to assess location environment, track location utilization, and verify location objective. These tasks enable conduct regular reviews and analyses to determine if the location continues to meet the needs of the organization and suggesting improvements or changes if necessary.

name: Assess Location Environment
brief_description: Assess Location Environment task is responsible for examining the adjacent environment (surrounding environment) of a location to ensure it meets organizations assessment criteria (including safety, compliance, and operational standards).
extended_description:
Assess Location Environment task is responsible for examining the adjacent environment (surrounding environment) of a location to ensure it meets organizations assessment criteria (including safety, compliance, and operational standards).
Assess Location Environment task includes actions for evaluating location factors (such as noise levels, air quality, and proximity to services and amenities etc.) to ensure the location provides a suitable environment for the organization's activities.

name: Track Location Utilization
brief_description: Track Location Utilization task is responsible for monitoring how spaces/zones/demarcated areas within a location are being used, and identifying usage patterns or trends.
extended_description:
Track Location Utilization task is responsible for monitoring how spaces/zones/demarcated areas within a location are being used, and identifying usage patterns or trends.
Track Location Utilization task includes actions for collecting location data such as occupancy, location resource usage, and location traffic flow etc. to inform future allocation and management decisions.

name: Verify Location Objective
brief_description: Verify Location Objective task is responsible for confirming that the location meets the strategic and operational goals set out by the organization.
extended_description:
Verify Location Objective task is responsible for confirming that the location meets the strategic and operational goals set out by the organization.
Verify Location Objective task includes reviewing the location's contribution to the organization's success and ensuring that it supports the overall mission and objectives.

name: Maintain Location
brief_description: Maintain Location task is responsible for ongoing upkeep and to sustain a location to ensure it remains functional and meets organizational standards.
extended_description:
Maintain Location task is responsible for ongoing upkeep and to sustain a location to ensure it remains functional and meets organizational standards.
Maintain Location task includes actions to monitor location, control location activity, manage location information documentation  and manage location compliance. These tasks cover scheduling regular maintenance, addressing need to maintain and update location information promptly and consistently, and updating upstream functions as required to keep the locations and location information in optimal condition.

name: Monitor Location
brief_description: Monitor Location task is responsible for regular observation and review of a location to ensure compliance and performance standards are met.
extended_description:
Monitor Location task is responsible for regular observation and review of a location to ensure compliance and performance standards are met.
Monitor Location task includes actions to conduct inspections, review location usage/access reports, and staying informed about any changes in regulations and/or policies that impact the location's operations.

name: Control Location Activity
brief_description: Control Location Activity task is responsible for overseeing and regulating the activities that take place within a location to maintain order and efficiency.
extended_description:
Control Location Activity task is responsible for overseeing and regulating the activities that take place within a location to maintain order and efficiency.
Control Location Activity task includes managing location activity schedules, coordinating location events, and implementing systems to streamline operations and prevent location usage conflicts or disruptions.

name: Manage Location Information Documentation
brief_description: Manage Location Information is responsible for collection, storage, and updates to information (including addresses, registration, titles etc.) of locations within the organization.
extended_description:
Manage Location Information Documentation is responsible for collection, storage, and updates to information (including addresses, registration, titles etc.) of locations within the organization.
Manage Location Information task includes actions to maintains a database of location information, ensuring location information is accurate and consistent, and making it location information accessible to those who need it through access control measures.

name: Manage Location Compliance
brief_description: Manage Location Compliance task is responsible for ensuring that all aspects of use of a location continue to adhere to relevant laws, regulations, and organizational policies.
extended_description:
Manage Location Compliance task is responsible for ensuring that all aspects of use of a location continue to adhere to relevant laws, regulations, and organizational policies.
Manage Location Compliance task includes actions to stay up-to-date with legal requirements, conducting compliance audits, and implementing corrective actions to maintain policy stipulations, as well as legal and regulatory standards for location usage.

name: Sales Strategy Management
brief_description: Develop an appropriate sales strategy to complement the market strategy.
extended_description:
Sales Strategy Management involves developing sales partner/alliance relationship, establish overall sales budgets, establish sales goals and measures, establish customer management measures, set service levels and standards and develop channel strategy, establish revenue/coverage plan.
Sales Strategy & Planning involves initiating the development of sales relationships with other parties, establish overall sales budgets, establish sales goals and measures, establish customer management measures, set service levels and standards and develop channel strategy, establish revenue/coverage plan.

name: Develop Sales Relationship
brief_description: Set the overall relationship strategy and initiate the development of sales relationships with other parties, such as sales partnerships and brokering, in advance of entering into formal agreements. Identifying and entering into agreements with other partners.
extended_description:
Develop Sales Relationship sets the overall relationship strategy. It also initiates the development of sales relationships with other parties, such as sales partnerships and brokering, in advance of entering into formal agreements. Identifying and entering into agreements with other parties are managed Party Tender Management and Party Agreement Management. A party in the agreement may represent a sales channel for the other. This process initiates flows to these other processes as appropriate.

Strategies for managing relationships and relationship goals are identified and agreed upon. Sales relationship opportunities are identified along with the methods for selecting parties and for managing the relationship. Candidate parties are also identified.

This process also periodically analyzes relationship strategies and makes any necessary changes to them, including the removal of a strategy.

name: Establish Sales Budget
brief_description: Establish sales revenue, cost, and profit budgets for the enterprise.
extended_description:
Establish Sales Budgets calculate product revenue targets for the budget, determines variable and fixed costs and overhead budgets. It uses these to estimate net profit. The combination of all of these represents the sales budget for the enterprise.

This process also conducts reviews of the budget as appropriate and makes any changes to elements that compose it.

name: Establish Sales Goals and Measures
brief_description: Establish goals and measures for sales, customer management measures, and sales service level standards.
extended_description:
Establish Sales Goals and Measures sets sales goals and how they will be measured and how customer management sales related measures. Additionally sales service levels and standards are set.

This process also conducts reviews of goals, Sales Forecasts, measures, service levels, and standards as appropriate and adjusts them if needed.

name: Assess Sales Forecasts
brief_description: Evaluates forecasted sales data to reflect market demand and performance trends, providing insight for strategic sales planning and prioritization.
extended_description: Assess Sales Forecasts is the process of analyzing and validating forecasted sales data to determine its strategic relevance for sales strategy development. It uses forecast insights to accurately reflect market dynamics, customer demand, and internal performance trends, providing a sound basis for defining strategic sales objectives, priorities, and resource allocations.

name: Define Sales Metrics
brief_description: Defines the metrics, service levels, and performance standards used to measure sales goals
extended_description: Defines sales metrics, service levels, and performance standards, including the selection of KPIs, targets, thresholds, and measurement criteria needed to evaluate sales performance and support performance reviews and adjustments.

name: Review Sales Performance vs Goals
brief_description: Reviews actual sales performance against goals and established metrics to identify discrepancies and performance gaps.
extended_description: Review Sales Performance vs Goals reviews actual sales results against defined goals and metrics to identify discrepancies and performance gaps, analyze variances, and provide insights that support performance management and goal adjustment.

name: Adjust Sales Metrics
brief_description: Adjusts sales metrics and standards based on performance reviews and business needs.
extended_description: Adjust Sales Metrics adjusts sales goals, metrics, and standards based on performance reviews, forecasts, and business needs to maintain alignment with strategic objectives.

name: Develop Sales Channel Strategy
brief_description: Use revenue models assessment, analyze profit impact on possible sales channel structures, and develop sales channel scenarios to define sales channel strategy.
extended_description:
Develop Sales Channel Strategy by assessing and analyzing revenue models, profit impact based on possible channel sales channel structures. It also plans and develops scenarios that are used to define the final sales channel strategy.

This process also periodically analyzes the sales channel strategy and makes any necessary changes to them, including the removal of parts or all of the strategy. Removal of the complete strategy would require its redevelopment.

	• Use revenue models assessment

	• Analyze profit impact on possible sales channel structures

	• Develop sales channel scenarios to define sales channel strategy bb

name: Establish Revenue Coverage Plan
brief_description: Develop revenue targets, conduct financial and operational planning to support revenue objectives, and define sales account coverage plans.
extended_description:
Establish Revenue Coverage Plan develops revenue targets, conducts financial and operational planning to support revenue objectives, and define sales account coverage plans.

Revenue targets are developed in order to meet revenue objectives. Financial and operational plans are also developed to support revenue objectives.

Sales account coverage plans, which include the enterprise sales targets, are defined and communicated throughout the Sales organization including any channels outside of the enterprise that may have been developed by Develop Sales Relationship.

This process also conducts reviews of revenue coverage plan as appropriate and adjusts them if needed.

name: Sales Development
brief_description: Develop the Sales support and response for new and existing products, as well as existing and potential customers.
extended_description:
Sales Development processes develop the Sales support and response for new and existing products and services, as well as existing and potential customers.
Sales Development processes develop product related compensation plans, define product revenue targets, develop product related sales training, develop prospective customer identification methodology, develop selling processes/methods and procedures for new products.

As an aspect of this Sales Development processes define channels for selling the enterprise’s products. The purpose of the Support Selling processes is twofold - to administer and manage the operation of the various sales channels and to ensure that there is capability (for example, information, materials, systems and resources) to support the Selling processes so that they can operate effectively.
These processes monitor current selling trends, and are responsible for the optimization and/or redistribution of existing sales channel capability or for enabling new capability (people, facilities, infrastructure).
